article_content: Wednesday's release of audio recordings from the 911 calls made during the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting forced news organizations to make difficult — and sometimes unpopular — decisions about what to broadcast and what to withhold. News executives weighed the wishes of the Newtown, Connecticut, community against the journalistic imperative to cover one of the most significant stories of the past year. The recordings became available to media outlets Wednesday afternoon. CNN aired excerpts Thursday evening, including a call from the school’s secretary, one from a teacher shot in the foot, and another from a janitor relaying information to police. The report, preceded by anchor Jake Tapper’s warning of disturbing content, was also posted online. Immediately after the broadcast, CNN legal analyst Mark Geragos criticized the decision: 'Other than pure titillation, I don’t see any public interest served by this whatsoever.' Fox News Channel aired limited clips about an hour later, with anchor Shepard Smith stating they would 'not be airing the most gut-wrenching moments.' CBS planned to use select audio but excluded gunshot sounds. ABC and NBC chose not to broadcast or post any audio, though they reported on the content. In an internal email, NBC instructed staff: 'It is fine for all programs and the website to report on the controversy related to the release of the tapes and include quotes or information from the tapes, but without audio.' Despite media restrictions, the recordings were publicly accessible online. Outlets like BuzzFeed linked to the audio with clear warnings about disturbing content. Many journalists and media analysts agreed the tapes were inherently newsworthy but acknowledged their emotional toll, especially for those connected to the tragedy. Patricia Llodra, a Newtown Board of Selectmen member, said the release would 'create a new layer of pain for many in the Newtown community.' Al Tompkins of the Poynter Institute argued that while media have an obligation to fight for public records, they must weigh journalism’s value against potential harm. Tompkins urged editors to ask: 'What is your journalism value in using or not using these things, and would the good from using them outweigh the harm?' CNN’s Jeffrey Toobin said he likely wouldn’t have aired the clips but supported the judge’s decision to release them, asserting, 'This is a decision for journalists to make, not for the government.' Llodra, in a blog post, challenged journalists to imagine themselves as grieving parents, teachers, or survivors: 'What is the public good, and how do I balance that against the hurt?' Nearly a year after the shooting, the nation remains divided on how to respond to gun violence.
translated_content: संडी हूक इलेमेंटरी स्कूलच्या शूटिंगदरम्यान केलेल्या 911 कॉलच्या ऑडिओ रेकॉर्डिंग्जची तीनव्या दिवशी प्रकाशित करण्यात आली, ज्यामुळे मीडिया संस्था जे प्रसारित करायचे आणि जे टाळायचे याबाबत अतिशय कठीण — आणि कधीकधी अप्रिय — निर्णय घेण्यास भाग पाडले. बातमी अधिकाऱ्यांनी न्यूटाऊन, कनेक्टिकट येथील समुदायाची इच्छा आणि गेल्या वर्षातील सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या बातम्यांपैकी एकावर अहवाल देण्याचे सामाजिक जबाबदारी यांच्यात संतुलन ठेवले. रेकॉर्डिंग्ज तीनव्या दिवशी संध्याकाळी मीडियाला उपलब्ध झाल्या. सीएनएनने चौथ्या दिवशी संध्याकाळी काही तुकडे प्रसारित केले, ज्यात शाळेच्या सेक्रेटरीचा, पायात गोळी लागलेल्या शिक्षिकेचा आणि पोलिसांना माहिती देणाऱ्या जन्टरचा कॉल समाविष्ट होता. जॅक टॅपर यांनी विषयाचे भयानक असल्याचे निरीक्षण केले आणि नंतर हा अहवाल ऑनलाइन प्रसिद्ध करण्यात आला. प्रसारणानंतर तत्काळ सीएनएनचे कायदेमंडळ विश्लेषक मार्क जेरागोस यांनी हा निर्णय टीका केला: 'केवळ उत्सुकतेसाठीच, मला यामुळे कोणताही सार्वजनिक हित मिळत नाही असे दिसते.' फॉक्स न्यूज चॅनेलने एक तास नंतर काही ऑडिओ क्लिप्स प्रसारित केले, ज्यात अन्कर शेपर्ड स्मिथ यांनी सांगितले की ते 'सर्वात अतिशय वेदनादायक क्षणांचे प्रसारण करणार नाहीत.' सीबीएसने काही ऑडिओ क्लिप्स वापरण्याची योजना बनवली, पण गोळीबाराच्या आवाजांचा समावेश केला नाही. एबीसी आणि एनबीसीने कोणत्याही ऑडिओचे प्रसारण किंवा पोस्टिंग केले नाही, परंतु त्यांनी सामग्रीचा अहवाल दिला. एनबीसीने कर्मचाऱ्यांना आंतरिक ईमेलमध्ये सांगितले: 'तुम्ही सर्व कार्यक्रम आणि वेबसाइटवर रेकॉर्डिंग्जच्या प्रकाशित करण्याच्या वादावर अहवाल देऊ शकता आणि ऑडिओशिवाय रेकॉर्डिंग्जमधील संदर्भ किंवा माहिती समाविष्ट करू शकता.' मीडियाच्या मर्यादांच्या विरुद्ध, रेकॉर्डिंग्ज ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध होत्या. बझ़्ज़्बी यासारख्या काही बातमी निकालांनी ऑडिओवर 'विषाददायक सामग्री' असल्याचे स्पष्ट इशारे दिले. अनेक वृत्तपत्रकार आणि मीडिया विश्लेषकांनी त्या रेकॉर्डिंग्जची बातमीदारी आहे असे मानले, परंतु त्यांच्या भावनिक वेदनेची ओळख केली, खास करून शूटिंगशी संबंधित लोकांसाठी. न्यूटाऊनच्या बोर्ड ऑफ सेलेक्टमनच्या सदस्या पॅट्रिशिया ल्लोड्रा यांनी म्हटले की रेकॉर्डिंग्जचे प्रकाशन 'न्यूटाऊन समुदायातील अनेकांसाठी एक नवीन पातळीचा दुःख निर्माण करेल.' पॉइंटनर संस्थेचे सीनियर फॅकल्टी मेंबर अल टॉम्प्किन्स यांनी म्हटले की जरी मीडियाला सार्वजनिक रेकॉर्ड्ससाठी लढायचे असते, तरी त्यांनी जरूरीचे व्यावहारिक वैल्यू आणि नुकसान यांचे वजन ठेवायचे आहे. टॉम्प्किन्सने संपादकांना विचारावे: 'तुमच्या वृत्तपत्रकारितेचे मूल्य या गोष्टी वापरायचे किंवा वापरू नये यात काय आहे, आणि त्यांचा वापर करून झालेला फायदा नुकसानापेक्षा जास्त असेल का?' सीएनएनचे जेफ्री टूबिन यांनी म्हटले की त्यांनी रेकॉर्डिंग्ज प्रसारित केले नसते, परंतु न्यायाधीशाने त्यांचे प्रकाशन केले हे योग्य निर्णय होते, आणि त्यांनी म्हटले, 'हे निर्णय मीडियाला करायचा आहे, सरकारला नाही.' ल्लोड्रा, एका ब्लॉग पोस्टमध्ये, पत्रकारांना आव्हान दिले की ते स्वतःला दुःखी आईवडील, शिक्षक किंवा जिवंत बचलेल्यांच्या भूमिकेत ठेवायचे: 'सार्वजनिक फायदा काय आहे आणि मी त्याचे दुःखाशी कसे संतुलन ठेवू?' संडी हूक नंतर अंदाजे एक वर्ष झाले असताना, देश आत्तापर्यंत आग्रहाच्या प्रतिक्रियेबद्दल विभक्त आहे.

article_content: In early June 2012, heiress Kate Rothschild made her debut on Twitter amid a swirling public scandal involving her marriage to financier Ben Goldsmith. Just days after their separation became public, she shared a photo of her three young children stepping off a private jet in Italy, captioning it simply: 'plane relief.' The image, originally posted on Instagram, was liked by rapper Jay Electronica — a detail that quickly went viral. Around the same time, she posted a cryptic message: 'talespins and head rolls,' widely interpreted as a reference to the distorted narrative surrounding her life. Her husband, Ben Goldsmith, responded with a series of heated tweets, calling her 'appalling' and accusing her of prioritizing her public image over their children’s well-being. He claimed to have discovered intimate text exchanges between Kate and Jay Electronica, leading to a violent confrontation during which he was briefly arrested on suspicion of assault — though no charges were filed after he accepted a police caution. Kate’s team issued a statement denying all allegations of wrongdoing, asserting that misleading information had been deliberately leaked to the press to damage her reputation. She emphasized that her children remained her top priority and hinted at legal action. Meanwhile, Goldsmith received an outpouring of online support, with followers praising him and condemning his wife — some even calling her a 'fool.' The couple, married since 2003, had reportedly experienced growing tension as Kate immersed herself in the music industry under her label, Roundtable Records, adopting a more nocturnal lifestyle. Their separation followed a brief reconciliation after an earlier trial split. Friends say rumors of the affair had circulated for months, especially as Kate spent increasing time with Jay Electronica, who had recently returned to London from attending his grandmother’s funeral in the U.S., tweeting '#LoveIsOnTheWay.' Legal experts noted this case could set a precedent as one of the first high-profile divorces shaped entirely by social media, where tweets replaced court filings and public opinion became a central battleground. While both sides claim to be victims of misinformation, the emotional toll on their children remains the most poignant, yet least addressed, aspect of the saga.

तिने इटलीमध्ये एका खास विमानावरून आपल्या तीन लहान मुलांची फोटो शेअर केली, आणि तिच्या टिप्पणीत 'प्लेन रिलीफ' असे लिहिले. ही छायाचित्रे, इन्स्टाग्रामवर प्रसिद्ध केली होती, आणि रॅपर जे इलेक्ट्रॉनिका article_content: IndiGo has made history by becoming India’s first airline to operate more than 2,000 flights in a single day — a milestone no other Indian carrier has ever reached. Founded by Rahul Bhatia and launching operations on August 4, 2006, it took the airline over a decade to hit its first thousand daily flights in December 2017. But the second thousand? That came in just six years — even amid internal disputes between co-founders and the global pandemic. A big reason for this explosive growth? India’s unmatched rebound in domestic air travel after COVID-19. Today, IndiGo controls more than 60% of the domestic market and flies with a fleet of over 330 planes, with nearly 1,000 more aircraft on order through the 2030s. It’s not just big — it’s the biggest standalone airline in the country when it comes to passenger volume. Meanwhile, the Tata Group has reshaped the industry by merging Air India, AI Express, AirAsia India, and Vistara into one powerhouse, forming what many are calling a ‘mega Maharaja.’ With 470 new planes ordered, Air India is poised for a major comeback. In contrast, newer entrant Akasa Air has been rocked by pilot shortages and tech glitches, forcing flight cancellations and customer complaints. IndiGo has also wet-leased two wide-body jets from Turkish Airlines to serve Delhi-Istanbul and Mumbai-Istanbul routes. According to OAG’s October 2023 report, IndiGo ranks among the world’s top 10 airlines in both flight frequency and total seat capacity. Its network spans 85 domestic and 32 international cities, with bold plans to double its global footprint before 2030 — including new routes to Africa, Central Asia, and the Middle East. CEO Pieter Elbers called the 2,000-flight milestone a 'strategic leap' toward deeper connectivity and a better passenger experience, thanking customers and partners for helping turn the dream of connecting India into reality.
translated_content: इंडिगोने भारतातील पहिल्या विमानवाहतूक कंपनी म्हणून एका दिवसात 2,000 पेक्षा अधिक उड्डाणे चालवण्याचा इतिहास निर्माण केला आहे. राहुल भटिया यांच्या सहकार्याने 4 ऑगस्ट, 2006 रोजी सुरू झालेल्या ह्या विमानकंपनीला पहिल्या हजार दैनिक उड्डाणांपर्यंत पोहोचण्यास 11 वर्षे लागली, जे डिसेंबर 2017 मध्ये झाले. पण दुसरे हजार? ते फक्त सहा वर्षांत — त्याच दरम्यान कंपनीच्या सह-संस्थापकांमध्ये वाद आणि जागतिक महामारी देखील होती. या वेगवान वाढीचे मुख्य कारण? कोविड-19 नंतर भारतातील घरगुती विमान वाहतूकीचा अद्वितीय पुनर्जीवन. आज, इंडिगोची घरगुती बाजारात 60% पेक्षा अधिक वाट आहे आणि 330 पेक्षा अधिक विमानांच्या फ्लीटसह उड्डाणे करते, ज्याचे 1,000 पेक्षा अधिक विमान 2030 च्या मध्यापर्यंत आगामी आहेत. हे फक्त मोठे नाही — तर भारतातील विमान वाहतूकीच्या प्रवाशांच्या संख्येच्या दृष्टीने सर्वात मोठी स्वतंत्र कंपनी आहे. त्याचवेळी, टाटा ग्रुपने एअर इंडिया, एआय एक्सप्रेस, एअरअशिया इंडिया आणि विस्तारा यांचे एकात्मिकीकरण करून एका शक्तिशाली एककात रूपांतरित केले, ज्याला अनेक 'मेगा महाराजा' म्हणतात. 470 नवीन विमानांच्या ऑर्डरमुळे, एअर इंडिया एक मोठ्या यशाकडे वाटचाल करत आहे. तर नवीन प्रवेशकर्ते अकासा एअर याला पायलट निघून जाण्याची समस्या आणि तांत्रिक अडचणींमुळे उड्डाणे रद्द करावे लागत आहे आणि प्रवाशांकडून तक्रारी होत आहेत. इंडिगोने तुर्की एअरलाइन्सकडून दोन विस्तृत शरीराची विमाने भाड्याने घेतली आहेत, जी दिल्ली-इस्तांबूल आणि मुंबई-इस्तांबूल रूटवर वापरली जातात. ऑक्टोबर 2023 च्या OAG अहवालानुसार, इंडिगो ही वारंवारता आणि एकूण सीट क्षमतेच्या दृष्टीने जागतिक टॉप 10 विमानकंपन्यांपैकी एक आहे. त्याचे नेटवर्क 85 घरगुती आणि 32 आंतरराष्ट्रीय ठिकाणांवर आहे, आणि 2030 पर्यंत आपली जागतिक उपस्थिती दुप्पट करण्याची धोरणे आहेत — त्यात आफ्रिका, मध्य आशिया आणि मध्य पूर्व येथे नवीन उड्डाणे समाविष्ट आहेत. सीईओ पिएटर एलबर्स यांनी 2,000 उड्डाणांच्या या लक्षणाचे 'रणनीतिक उड्डाण' म्हणून उल्लेख केला, जे जास्तीत जास्त जोडणी आणि सुधारित प्रवासी अनुभवाकडे नेणार आहे, आणि भारतातील लोकांच्या आकांक्षांना जोडण्याच्या आपल्या ध्येयासाठी ग्राहक आणि सहकाऱ्यांचे हृदयापासून आभार व्यक्त केले.

article_content: The BBC and ITV are facing renewed criticism over their World Cup broadcast teams, as viewers express frustration with pundits struggling to communicate effectively in English. Former Brazil midfielder Juninho and Italian legend Fabio Cannavaro have become focal points of backlash, with audiences criticizing their limited command of the language and apparent difficulty understanding fellow analysts. This surge of complaints follows 445 formal grievances lodged with the BBC over Phil Neville’s perceived dull commentary during England’s 14.4-million-viewer match against Italy. On social media, viewers called Juninho’s contributions 'incomprehensible' and questioned why he was selected for the panel. Cannavaro, too, drew sharp criticism after appearing on both BBC and ITV. One Twitter user suggested pundits should be required to pass English proficiency tests before going on air. Another quipped that Cannavaro had listed 'conversational English' on his CV—and ITV took him at his word. Adding to the controversy, veteran BBC commentator Jonathan Pearce was widely mocked for a baffling segment during France vs. Honduras, where he failed to grasp how goal-line technology worked. As a computer animation first indicated 'no goal' before switching to 'goal' upon the ball crossing the line, Pearce appeared confused and launched into an angry monologue—only clarified when co-presenter Martin Keown intervened. Online commentators ridiculed Pearce’s misunderstanding, with screenwriter Dave Turner joking he seemed confused by 'linear time,' and comedian Dara O'Brien urging someone to explain the tech to him. While the BBC defended Pearce as an 'important, well-respected' figure, questions remain about who will anchor future coverage if England advances beyond the group stage. A spokesperson told The Telegraph that decisions for the Round of 16 will be made 'much closer to the time.'

article_content: Investigators in Chicago are working to determine how a severed human leg ended up on the shores of Lake Michigan on June 5, 2013—and to whom it belongs. According to the Chicago Sun-Times, the leg was discovered on a beach in the Kenwood neighborhood on Chicago’s South Side on Wednesday afternoon. Police received a report at approximately 2:42 p.m. that a severed human leg had washed ashore. The leg, severed just below the hip, was found by a pedestrian walking along the 4700 block of South Lake Shore Drive. This marks the second time in two weeks that human remains have been recovered from the Great Lakes. On May 22, authorities in Toronto found a bag containing human remains floating near Yonge Street. The remains were later identified as female, though the individual has not yet been named. In Chicago, an autopsy is scheduled for today at the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office to determine the identity and cause of death.

article_content: Experts claim that dinosaurs breathed through their noses not only to detect scents but also to regulate brain temperature. This conclusion comes from the first-ever reconstruction of how these prehistoric animals breathed, based on advanced 3D modeling of nasal passages. Scientists at Ohio University studied the nasal anatomy of Cretaceous pachycephalosaurids — small, plant-eating dinosaurs known for their thick, bony skulls. Using CT scans of a well-preserved Stegoceras fossil from Canada, researchers identified intricate internal structures, including long, thin bones called turbinates in the rear of the nasal cavity and a prominent bony ridge at the front. These features closely resemble those found in modern-day ostriches and alligators, prompting the team to investigate how airflow might have functioned in these extinct creatures. Jason Bourke, a doctoral student involved in the study, noted the challenge of interpreting nasal function without preserved soft tissues, which decayed millions of years ago. To solve this mystery, the researchers turned to computational fluid dynamics — a branch of engineering used to simulate airflow. By testing various configurations of hypothetical cartilaginous turbinates attached to the bony ridge, they found that only models incorporating respiratory turbinates in the front of the nasal passage allowed odor molecules to reach the olfactory region effectively. Surprisingly, these same structures also appear to have served a thermoregulatory purpose: as warm blood from the body passed over the respiratory turbinates, it cooled before reaching the brain. 'You don’t want your brain cooked,' said study co-author Ruger Porter, highlighting the importance of this cooling mechanism even in animals with relatively small brains. The findings suggest that pachycephalosaurids — which lived in North America during the Late Cretaceous, measured up to 15 feet long, weighed about 990 pounds, and walked on two legs — possessed sophisticated nasal systems comparable to those of modern reptiles and birds. The team now aims to apply these methods to understand breathing patterns in other dinosaur species.

'तुम्हाला तुमचा मेंदू उकळू देता येणार नाही,' असे अभ्यासाचे सह-लेखक रुगर पॉर्टर यांनी सांगितले, जे सांगतात की थोड्या मेंदू असल्यासह हे थंड करणे महत्त्वाचे आहे. हे निष्कर्ष सूचित करतात की पॅकीफेलोसॉरिड्स — जे उत्तर अमेरिकेमध्ये क्रेटेशियस काळात राहत होते, 15 फूट लांब, जवळजवळ 990 पौंड वजन आणि दोन पायांवर चालत होते — आधुनिक सरीसृप आणि पक्षींच्या नाकाच्या प्रणालीशी तुलनीय असलेल्या जटिल नाक प्रणाली धारण करत होते. संशोधक आता इतर डायनासोरच्या श्वासोच्छ्वासाचे निरीक्षण करण्यासाठी ही पद्धत लागू करण्याचा प्रयत्न करत आहेत.

article_content: Debra Cox, a former bank manager in east London, exploited her role to steal over £200,000 from her own family and close friends over a four-year period. Using the identities of her in-laws and trusted acquaintances, she fraudulently secured personal loans and opened hidden bank accounts, then transferred the funds—piecemeal—to her mother, Carol Collier. Together, they used the stolen money to fund luxury holidays and a lifestyle far beyond their legitimate means, convinced that wealth would equate to happiness. The fraud came to light in early 2010 when Cox’s ex-husband, Dave Cox, spotted suspicious activity in family accounts and reported it to HSBC. The bank launched an investigation that revealed Cox had illegally accessed confidential financial records, redirected all correspondence to her parents’ address, and forged documents to approve transactions—all while holding senior roles that required trust and integrity. Although Cox argued that her actions were not initially malicious and grew out of control, the court rejected this as insufficient mitigation. Her mother, Carol Collier, was also convicted for knowingly receiving stolen funds, even if she did not initiate the scheme. Both women pleaded not guilty but were found guilty following a four-week trial. HSBC reimbursed every victim in full, but the emotional scars lingered. Judge Inigo Bing emphasized that the deepest violation was not financial—it was the betrayal of familial trust. He noted that Cox abused both her professional responsibilities and the love of those closest to her. While Collier’s sentence was reduced due to her husband’s serious illness, the court underscored that accepting stolen money, even passively, constitutes a criminal act.

article_content: Colour Sergeant James Harkess, a revered Iraq War veteran who earned one of Britain’s most prestigious military honors, is selling his collection of medals to cope with debilitating health issues that have left him unable to work. At 46, Harkess served 22 years in the Army and was awarded the Conspicuous Gallantry Cross — the nation’s second-highest award for bravery — for three separate acts of extraordinary courage during intense combat in 2006. In one harrowing battle on June 11, his Warrior armored vehicle crew survived a six-hour siege by around 200 Mahdi Army fighters in Al Amarah, enduring RPGs, machine gun fire, snipers, and blast bombs. Exposed in the turret throughout the fight, Harkess kept firing nonstop, helping his team eliminate roughly 50 enemy combatants. He recalls seeing bodies pile up as attackers surged forward in waves, only to be replaced moments later. Harkess also led rescue missions under fire on May 23 and July 30, 2006, personally eliminating two snipers who had pinned down his unit. Though he deeply misses his military service, Harkess says he accepted his departure from the Army last year. Now, facing chronic illness and relying only on his pension, he hopes the auction of his medals — including the CGC — will raise around £120,000 to ease his financial burden. The medals will be sold by London-based auction house Dix Noonan Webb on February 25. Experts describe Harkess as embodying the rarest kind of battlefield leadership, comparing his actions to some of the fiercest urban combat since World War II. The CGC, established in 1993, replaces older gallantry awards and is open to all service ranks. Its silver cross design features a laurel wreath and a distinctive blue-and-crimson ribbon, with the recipient’s details engraved on the reverse.

article_content: CNN) -- Britain's Andy Murray has turned to former great Ivan Lendl in his quest to win his first Grand Slam title. The world No. 4 made the surprise announcement on Saturday, appointing the Czech legend as his coach ahead of the 2012 season. The 51-year-old Lendl, an eight-time Grand Slam champion and former World No. 1, has never served as a full-time coach on the ATP Tour. But Murray — who has lost in three Grand Slam finals and reached the semifinals of all four majors this year — believes Lendl’s experience will prove invaluable. 'Ivan's impact on the game is unquestionable, and he brings experience and knowledge that few others possess, particularly in major tournaments,' Murray said on his official website. Lendl, who spent 270 weeks ranked World No. 1, is eager for the challenge: 'I am really excited to have the opportunity to work with Andy. He is a unique talent, and I look forward to helping him reach his goals.' Lendl will begin his role immediately as Murray kicks off his new season with a first-round match against Kazakhstan’s Mikhail Kukushkin at the Brisbane International on Tuesday. His first major target will be the Australian Open, where Murray most recently reached a Grand Slam final, losing in straight sets to World No. 1 Novak Djokovic earlier this year. In March, Murray parted ways with Spanish Davis Cup captain Alex Corretja and had remained without a coach until appointing Lendl.

article_content: Most people are content with a £1.80 pack of Andrex toilet paper—but for those seeking an indulgent, almost regal experience, there’s Hanebisho, a Japanese brand marketed as the world’s most expensive toilet paper. A three-pack costs around 5,000 yen (£32), making each roll roughly £11—more than six times the price of an average supermarket brand. Crafted from the finest Canadian wood fibre pulp and purified with water from the Nyodo River—ranked Japan’s cleanest river in 2010 by the Ministry of Environment—Hanebisho undergoes a meticulous, pancake-like production process. Heat is applied with precision to ensure unparalleled softness without burning. Each roll is personally signed by its maker with the production date, then submitted to the company president, who reportedly tests every roll on his own skin—a practice claimed to have continued for the past decade, according to OddityCentral.com. The rolls are then wrapped in elegant, hand-decorated paper and housed in boxes lined with silver leaf. According to Hanebisho’s website, the experience feels 'as if your skin is being gently swathed in silk.' The brand claims to have presented the product to the Emperor of Japan annually for five years, though no official confirmation exists. One delighted customer shared that they gifted Hanebisho to their father for Father’s Day—and so captivated was he by its beauty that he displayed it in the living room.

article_content: Saturday Night Live (SNL) was born in the turbulent mid-1970s, when Watergate shattered public trust in politicians, countercultural humor surged, and audiences craved bold, fresh television. Now, 34 years later, SNL continues to stir political discourse — most recently with Fred Armisen’s portrayal of President Barack Obama. In a widely discussed sketch, Armisen, as Obama, dismissed claims that he was turning America into the Soviet Union or Nazi Germany. 'When you look at my record,' he deadpanned, 'it’s very clear what I’ve done so far — and that is nothing.' The line drew laughter, but also serious reactions from political commentators. Washington Post blogger Jonathan Capehart noted that when influential voices — especially ones with a national platform like SNL — begin framing a president this way, the White House should pay attention. CNN’s Ed Rollins warned that persistent ridicule, even in jest, can chip away at a leader’s standing. The White House declined to comment. SNL cast members and creator Lorne Michaels also stayed silent, though Michaels has previously stated the show’s mission isn’t partisanship — but opposition. 'Once they’re in power,' he told CNN, 'we’re the opposition. We’re not putting on anything we don’t believe is funny.' Robert Thompson, a pop culture professor at Syracuse University, sees the sketch as a sign that Obama’s political honeymoon is over. 'Comedy goes after the people in power,' he said. But he cautioned against overstating its significance: 'This isn’t a viral meme like Tina Fey’s Palin. The sketch wasn’t that funny.' David Greenberg, a media scholar at Rutgers, agrees that SNL rarely shapes narratives anymore — it mostly mirrors them. While iconic moments like Dan Aykroyd’s Nixon or Fey’s Palin had sharp political edges, today’s impersonations often lack deeper critique. He questioned how many beyond the political insider bubble even noticed the sketch. Ratings support his skepticism: the episode scored a 4.7 — well below the 7.3 from the same week in 2008 during the Palin frenzy. Online buzz also paled in comparison. Still, Thompson points to a subtle shift: past SNL satire targeted presidents’ quirks — Clinton’s appetite, Bush’s speech patterns. Obama, lacking such easy targets, is now being judged on his record. 'In some ways,' Thompson said, 'he’s more vulnerable to real damage.'
translated_content: सॅटरडे नाइट लाइव्ह (SNL) ही मध्य-1970 च्या उथळपणात जन्मली, जेव्हा वॉटरगेटमुळे राजकारण्यांबाबत जनतेचा विश्वास ध्वस्त झाला, ग्रामीण संस्कृतीचा हास्य वाढला आणि प्रेक्षकांना नवीन आणि धाडसी टेलिव्हिजन हवे होते. आता, 34 वर्षांनंतर, SNL राजकीय चर्चेला जोर देत राहिली आहे — अलीकडे फ्रेड अर्मिसेनच्या बराक ओबामा यांच्या भूमिकेमुळे. एका चर्चेत अर्मिसेन, ओबामा म्हणून, त्याच्यामुळे अमेरिका सोव्हिएत यूनियन किंवा नाझी जर्मनी बनत आहे अशी दावे नकारली. 'जेव्हा तुम्ही माझा रेकॉर्ड पाहाता,' तो म्हणाला, 'तुम्हाला खूप स्पष्ट दिसते की मी आत्तापर्यंत काय केले आहे — आणि ते म्हणजे काहीही नाही.' ही ओळ हसली, पण राजकीय टिप्पणीकारांकडून गंभीर प्रतिक्रिया आली. वॉशिंग्टन पोस्टचे ब्लॉगर जोनाथन कॅपहार्ट यांनी नोट केले की जेव्हा प्रभावी आवाज — विशेषतः SNL सारख्या राष्ट्रीय मंचावर — एका अध्यक्षाला अशा पद्धतीने चित्रित करू लागतात, तेव्हा व्हाईट हाऊस लक्ष द्यावे. सीएनएनचे एड रोलिन्स यांनी चेतवले की निरंतर हास्य, जरी खेळाच्या रूपात असले तरी, नेत्याच्या स्थितीवर घातक परिणाम करू शकते. व्हाईट हाऊसने टिप्पणी केली नाही. SNL कलाकार आणि निर्माते लोरन मायकेल्स यांनीही शांत राहायला निवडले, तरी मायकेल्सने आधी सांगितले होते की दाखवण्याचे उद्दिष्ट राजकीय विषय नाही — पण विरोध आहे. 'जेव्हा ते अधिकारात येतात,' त्यांनी सीएनएनला सांगितले, 'आम्ही विरोधक आहोत. आम्ही काहीही दाखवत नाही जे आम्हाला गंभीरपणे वाटत नाही.' सिर्यॅक्युस विद्यापीठाचे पॉप कल्चर प्रोफेसर रॉबर्ट थॉम्पसन हे हे स्केच ओबामाच्या राजकीय हनुमानच्या शेवटाचे संकेत मानतात. 'हास्य हे अधिकारात असलेल्यांवर जाते,' ते म्हणाले. पण त्यांनी त्याचा अर्थ अधिक लावण्याची इच्छा न केलेली सांगितली: 'हे टिना फे यांच्या पॅलिन स्केचसारखा व्हायरल मीम नाही. हे स्केच फार गंभीर नव्हते.' रुटगर्स विद्यापीठाचे मीडिया अभ्यासक डेव्हिड ग्रीनबर्ग यांचे म्हणणे आहे की SNL आता जवळजवळ कधीच निर्माण करत नाही — ती फक्त प्रतिबिंबित करते. जेव्हा डॅन एक्रॉयडचे निक्सन किंवा फे यांचे पॅलिन हे अत्यंत तीव्र राजकीय आक्रमण होते, तेव्हा आजचे अनुकरण अनेकदा खोल टीका नसते. त्यांनी विचारले की राजकीय आंतरिक वर्गाबाहेर कोणाला ते स्केच ठाऊक आहे? रेटिंग्ज या शंकेला आधार देतात: हा एपिसोड 4.7 रेटिंग असून, 2008 मधील पॅलिन फ्रेनेझीच्या तुलनेत 7.3 च्या खाली आहे. ऑनलाइन चर्चा देखील फार कमी होती. तरीही, थॉम्पसन एक निर्माणात्मक बदल लक्षात घेतात: जुन्या SNL टीका अध्यक्षांच्या वैयक्तिक वैशिष्ट्यांवर होत्या — क्लिंटनचे भोजन, बुशचे बोलणे. ओबामा, ज्यांच्याकडे अशी सोपी वैशिष्ट्ये नव्हती, त्यांच्या रेकॉर्डवर टीका केली जात आहे. 'काही अर्थाने,' थॉम्पसन म्हणाले, 'त्यांची खरी नुकसानीची शक्यता जास्त आहे.'

article_content: Arturo Vidal has not closed the door on a potential move to Manchester United, sparking renewed rumors about a possible transfer to Old Trafford. While Juventus director general Giuseppe Marotta confirmed the club would not prevent Vidal from leaving if he felt the time was right, the 27-year-old midfielder insists his only focus is on training. After a session in Singapore, Vidal told The Mirror, 'My future is to train well,' deflecting questions about his next club. Despite his public denial, speculation lingers — especially after Vidal was seen signing a Manchester United jersey for a fan, an act some interpreted as symbolic. His recent recovery from knee cartilage surgery in May, followed by a rapid return to play in the World Cup, has raised concerns among scouts about his long-term durability. Manchester United manager Louis van Gaal is actively searching for a central midfield star, but hesitates due to injury history. Meanwhile, Juventus boss Massimiliano Allegri is determined to keep Vidal, a vital part of his squad. Back in England, former United legend Paul Scholes voiced frustration over the club’s summer recruitment, pointing to their 1-0 opening-day loss to Swansea. 'They miss players like Evra, Vidic, and Ferdinand,' Scholes said. 'Look at how young and raw they looked. And now, with all this spending — who’s actually coming in? Where are Kroos and Fàbregas?'

'त्यांना एव्ह्रा, विडिक आणि रिओ यांची आवश्यकता आहे,' शॉल्स म्हणाले. 'त्यांच्या तरुण आणि अनुभवहीन खेळाडूंना पाहा. आणि आता या मोठ्या खर्चानंतर — कोण येत आहे? क्रोस आणि फाब्रेगास कुठे आहेत?'

article_content: In Madrid, thousands returned to Puerta del Sol — the heart of Spain’s rising anti-crisis movement — as social media sparked a wave of spontaneous protests ahead of Sunday’s local elections. Unlike earlier rallies led by unions, this surge is fueled by everyday citizens disillusioned by an economy that leaves them behind. With unemployment at 21% and nearly five million Spaniards jobless, frustration is building over temporary contracts offering no security or benefits. Jon Aguirre Such of Real Democracy Now said economic pain binds protesters: 'While some get richer, most of us are falling further behind.' Elena Ortega, a woman struggling to secure steady work for herself and her 20-year-old son, pointed to social media as the catalyst for action. 'The unions didn’t do what was needed, when it was needed,' she said. 'Forty percent of our young people have no future.' Economist Fernando Fernandez of IE Business School called the movement unprecedented — decentralized, leaderless, and born from digital networks. 'We’re seeing the beginning of something new,' he remarked, though he doesn’t expect it to swell into a massive, long-term uprising. Yet authorities intervened: Madrid’s election board banned a planned evening protest at Puerta del Sol, claiming it lacked adequate notice and might disrupt voters’ freedom. Police were positioned to prevent the gathering, despite the fact that prior protests had also been organized with little warning. Similar demonstrations erupted in Barcelona and over thirty other cities, with organizers pledging to keep the momentum alive until election day.

'यूनियन्सनी आवश्यक असलेले काम आवश्यक वेळी केले नाही,' तिने म्हटले. 'आमच्या 40 टक्के तरुणांना भविष्य नाही.' आयई बिझनेस स्कूलचे अर्थशास्त्रज्ञ फर्नांडो फर्नांडेझ या चळवळीला अप्रतिम म्हणाले — विकेंद्रीकृत, नेतृत्वरहित आणि डिजिटल नेटवर्क्समधून उद्भवलेली. 'आम्ही काहीतरी नवीन घडत आहे,' त्यांनी टिप्पणी केली, परंतु ते याचे एक मोठे, दीर्घकालीन उठाव बनेल असे वाटत नाही. परंतु अधिकाऱ्यांनी हालचाल केली: मॅड्रिडच्या निवडणूक मंडळाने पुएर्ता देल सोल येथे रात्रीचे प्रदर्शन बंदी घातले, कारण ते योग्य नोटीस नसल्याचे आणि मतदानाच्या स्वातंत्र्याला धोका निर्माण करू शकते असे म्हटले. पोलिसांना या गोष्टी रोखण्यासाठी तयार करण्यात आले, यापूर्वीच्या प्रदर्शनांनीही थोड्या वेळातच आयोजित केले होते. बार्सिलोना आणि तीसहून अधिक इतर शहरांमध्ये समान प्रदर्शने झाली, आणि आयोजकांनी निवडणूक दिवसापर्यंत चळवळ चालू ठेवण्याचे वचन दिले.

article_content: After more than five decades in journalism, Jim Lehrer is stepping back from his daily role as anchor of the PBS Newshour, effective June 6. Though he’s leaving the weekday broadcasts, Lehrer will continue contributing to the program by offering editorial insight and hosting a weekly panel featuring columnists Mark Shields and David Brooks. His journey with the show began in 1975 as Washington correspondent for the then-new 'Robert MacNeil Report.' By 1976, it became 'The MacNeil/Lehrer Report,' and after MacNeil’s retirement in 1995, it was renamed 'The NewsHour with Jim Lehrer.' In 2009, he voluntarily removed his name from the title, transitioning to a multi-anchor format that still includes him. In a statement, Lehrer reflected on 52 years in the field — 36 of them with this program — saying it was simply time to let go of the daily grind. Robert MacNeil praised the transition as one of the most thoughtful and dignified exits he’d ever witnessed in modern media, ensuring the show remains anchored in thoughtful reporting amid a chaotic media landscape.

article_content: Islamabad (CNN) — The second-largest party in Pakistan’s ruling coalition withdrew from the government on Sunday over rising fuel prices and other grievances, leaving the country with a minority administration. The Muttahida Qaumi Movement (MQM), which holds 25 seats in the National Assembly, announced its decision to join the opposition — a move that followed multiple prior threats to exit. Prime Minister Yousuf Raza Gilani asserted that the Pakistan People’s Party (PPP)-led government could continue operating without a parliamentary majority, noting that the assembly retains the authority to elect the prime minister. 'Just because one party pulls out does not mean the government will collapse,' Gilani told reporters. MQM, one of Pakistan’s largest and most secular parties, has its main base in Karachi. Its departure follows the December exit of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazal, a prominent religious party. Muhammad Anwar, a senior MQM coordinator, told CNN that the immediate trigger was Saturday’s fuel price hikes: gasoline rose 9.2%, and kerosene increased by nearly 6%, justified by the government as necessary due to higher global crude oil costs. Anwar also accused the government of failing to combat widespread corruption and restore law and order — particularly in Karachi and the broader Sindh province. He claimed businessmen in Karachi are effectively held hostage by kidnapping and extortion networks. MQM leader Faisal Sabzwari added that the PPP-led government has imposed regressive taxes on low-income groups and neglected the worsening energy crisis. Last week, MQM removed its two federal cabinet ministers — a move described by party leaders as a formal warning. The PPP, which came to power in 2008 with 147 seats in the 342-member National Assembly, now governs without a majority. Anwar emphasized that MQM does not seek the government’s downfall, stating, 'The government is failing itself through its own actions.' CNN’s Aliza Kassim and journalist Nasir Habib contributed to this report.
translated_content: इस्लामाबाद (सीएनएन) — पाकिस्तानच्या राज्यकर्त्या सहकार्यातील दुसऱ्या सर्वात मोठ्या पक्षाने ईंधन किंमत वाढीच्या आणि इतर तक्रारींच्या कारणांनी शनिवारी सरकार सोडली, ज्यामुळे देशाला अल्पमत सरकार उरले. राष्ट्रीय असेंब्लीमध्ये २५ सदस्य असलेल्या मुत्तहिदा क़ुमी मूव्हमेंट (MQM) ने विरोधी पक्षात सामील होण्याचा निर्णय घेतला — हा निर्णय आधीच्या अनेक धमक्यांनंतर घेतला गेला. पंतप्रधान यूसुफ रझा गिलानी यांनी असे म्हटले की, पाकिस्तान लोकशाही पक्ष (PPP) नेतृत्वाखालील सरकार बहुमताशिवाय काम करू शकते, कारण असेंब्लीची जबाबदारी आहे पंतप्रधान निवडणे. 'फक्त एक पक्ष बाहेर पडला, तरी सरकार ढासळणार नाही,' गिलानी यांनी पत्रकारांना सांगितले. MQM हा पाकिस्तानचा एक मोठा आणि धर्मनिरपेक्ष पक्ष आहे, ज्याचे मुख्य केंद्र कराची येथे आहे. त्याची बाहेर पडणे डिसेंबरमध्ये जमियत उलेमा-ए-इस्लाम-फझल उर रहमान यांच्या बाहेर पडण्यानंतर झाली. MQM चे एक तज्ञ समन्वयक मुहम्मद अन्वर यांनी सीएनएनला सांगितले की, शनिवारी झालेल्या ईंधन किंमत वाढीने हा निर्णय घेतला: गॅसोलिनची किंमत ९.२% वाढली, आणि केरोसिनची किंमत जवळपास ६% वाढली, जे सरकारने जागतिक कच्च्या तेलाच्या वाढीच्या कारणांनी आवश्यक ठरवले. अन्वर यांनी सरकारवर व्यापक भ्रष्टाचार रोखण्यात अपयश आणि कराची आणि सिंध प्रांतात कायदा-व्यवस्था राखण्यात अपयश याचा आरोप केला. त्यांनी म्हटले की कराचीतील व्यापारी अपहरण आणि जबरदस्तीच्या गटांच्या बळी बनले आहेत. MQM चे नेते फैसल सबझवरी यांनी असे सांगितले की, PPP नेतृत्वाखालील सरकारने गरिबांवर अनुचित कर लादले आहे आणि ऊर्जा संकटाला निर्लक्ष केले आहे. मागील आठवड्यात, MQM ने फेडरल सरकारमधील दोन मंत्री राजीनामा दिले — हे एक अधिकृत चेतावणी म्हणून देण्यात आले. २००८ मध्ये ज्यावेळी PPP ने ३४२ सदस्यांच्या राष्ट्रीय असेंब्लीमध्ये १४७ जागा मिळवल्या, तेव्हा ते सत्तेवर आले, आणि आता ते बहुमताशिवाय राज्य करत आहेत. अन्वर यांनी म्हटले की MQM सरकारचा पतन इच्छित नाही, पण 'सरकार स्वतःच्या कृतींमुळे स्वतःच अपयशी ठरत आहे.' सीएनएनच्या अलिझा कासिम आणि पत्रकार नसीर हबीब यांनी हा अहवाल तयार केला.

article_content: For years, the familiar whistle of a boiling kettle remained a mystery — until researchers at Cambridge University cracked the code. They discovered that the sound isn't just random noise; it's created by how steam rushes through the kettle’s narrow spout. As steam builds up and flows upward, it hits a tight opening at the base of the whistle. This forces the steam into a fast-moving jet, triggering tiny swirls called vortices. These swirling air pockets vibrate at specific frequencies, producing the iconic whistle. At slower steam speeds, the whistle acts like a Helmholtz resonator — similar to the hum you get when blowing across the top of a bottle. But once the flow exceeds a certain threshold, vortex-driven noise takes over. To test this, scientists used a controlled setup to push air through simplified kettle whistles at varying speeds, recording and analyzing the resulting sounds with precision tools, including a dual-microphone system to measure internal frequencies. The findings, while seemingly small, could have big implications: understanding how these whistles form may help engineers silence annoying noises in car exhausts, industrial pipes, and other systems where turbulent airflow causes unwanted sound.

article_content: Former NBA star Dennis Rodman has faced intense backlash for his controversial remarks about Kenneth Bae, a U.S. citizen detained in North Korea. Rodman, currently in Pyongyang for a basketball exhibition game timed to coincide with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un’s birthday, described Kim as a 'beloved friend' during an emotional interview with CNN’s Chris Cuomo. When pressed about Bae — a Korean-American who was sentenced to 15 years in a labor camp in 2012 on charges widely regarded as fabricated — Rodman responded defensively, suggesting Bae must have done something wrong without providing evidence. 'Do you understand what he did in this country?' Rodman asked Cuomo. 'You tell me.' Bae’s family, including his sister Terri Chung and mother Myunghee Bae, expressed shock and anger. They emphasized that Bae, a devoted Christian and father of three, was in North Korea legally as a tour operator and has suffered severe health deterioration during his imprisonment. Terri Chung accused Rodman of failing to use his access to Kim to advocate for her brother’s release, calling his comments 'outrageous' and 'appalling.' U.S. officials also condemned Rodman’s statements. Former UN Ambassador Bill Richardson said Rodman 'crossed a line' by implying Bae was guilty. 'There is no crime,' Richardson asserted. 'He deserves to come home.' While Rodman framed his visits as 'basketball diplomacy,' the NBA and White House distanced themselves from the trip. NBA Commissioner David Stern said the league had no involvement and criticized the mission as lacking dignity. White House spokesperson Jay Carney reaffirmed the U.S. stance: Bae’s health is a grave concern, and his immediate release should be granted on humanitarian grounds. Other members of the delegation, including former player Charles D. Smith, defended the trip as a non-political effort to foster cultural understanding through basketball. Smith clarified that Rodman’s use of the word 'friend' was overstated — Kim is merely an acquaintance. The group, which included 40 people, emphasized they were not diplomats, but athletes seeking to connect through sport. Rodman, however, remained defiant, accusing critics of misunderstanding the courage it took for the players to visit a repressive regime. 'We’re going to take the abuse,' he said. Yet many argue that in a country where dissent is punished by imprisonment or execution, such gestures risk legitimizing tyranny rather than challenging it.
translated_content: माजी एनबीए स्टार डेनिस रॉडमन यांनी उत्तर कोरियामध्ये अटकेखाली असलेल्या अमेरिकन नागरिक केनेथ बेयच्या विषयी केलेल्या विवादास्पद टिप्पण्यांसाठी जोरदार आलोचना भोगली आहे. किम जोंग उनच्या जन्मदिनाच्या निमित्ताने घडलेल्या बास्केटबॉल दर्शनी सामन्यासाठी प्यॉंगयांगमध्ये असलेल्या रॉडमन यांनी सीएनएनच्या क्रिस कुमोच्या साक्षात्कारात किमला 'प्रिय मित्र' म्हणून ओळखले. केनेथ बेयच्या विषयी विचारले असता — ज्याला 2012 मध्ये निर्माण केलेल्या आरोपांवर 15 वर्षांची शिक्षा झाली होती — रॉडमन यांनी आपल्या आत्मरक्षणात बेयला काहीतरी चुकीचे केल्याचे सूचित केले, परंतु कोणतेही साक्ष दिले नाही. 'तुम्हाला या देशात त्याने काय केले ते समजते?' रॉडमन यांनी कुमोला विचारले. 'तुम्ही मला सांगा.' बेयचे कुटुंब, त्याची बहीण तेरी चुंग आणि आई म्युंगही बेय, यांनी आश्चर्य आणि क्रोध व्यक्त केले. त्यांनी भर देऊन सांगितले की बेय हा एक धार्मिक ख्रिश्चन आणि तीन मुलांचे वडील होता, तो उत्तर कोरियामध्ये पर्यटन ऑपरेटर म्हणून कायदेशीररित्या होता आणि त्याचे आरोग्य त्याच्या अटकदरम्यान खूप खराब झाले आहे. तेरी चुंग यांनी रॉडमनवर आरोप केला की त्यांनी किमशी असलेल्या त्यांच्या संपर्काचा वापर त्यांच्या भाऊच्या सोडवणुकीसाठी केला नाही, आणि त्यांच्या टिप्पण्यांना 'अतिशय भयानक' आणि 'आश्चर्यचकित करणारे' असे म्हटले. अमेरिकेचे अधिकारीही रॉडमनच्या टिप्पण्यांची निंदा केली. माजी संयुक्त राष्ट्रांचे राजदूत बिल रिचर्डसन यांनी म्हटले की रॉडमनने 'रेष ओलांडली' आणि बेय दोषी आहे असे सूचित केल्यामुळे. 'कोणताही गुन्हा नाही,' रिचर्डसन यांनी दावा केला. 'त्याला घरी येण्याचा हक्क आहे.' रॉडमनने त्यांच्या भेटींना 'बास्केटबॉल डिप्लोमसी' असे ओळखले, परंतु एनबीए आणि व्हाईट हाऊस यांनी या प्रवासाचे अंतर ठेवले. एनबीएचे माजी कमिशनर डेविड स्टर्न यांनी सांगितले की लीगचे या प्रवासाशी काही संबंध नव्हता आणि हा प्रवास निष्ठुर आहे. व्हाईट हाऊसचे प्रवक्ते जे कार्नी यांनी अमेरिकेचे स्थिती पुन्हा स्पष्ट केली: बेयचे आरोग्य गंभीर आहे, आणि त्याची तात्काळ सोडवणूक मानवीय कारणांसाठी देण्यात यावी. प्रवासातील इतर सदस्य, ज्यांमध्ये माजी खेळाडू चार्ल्स डी. स्मिथ यांचा समावेश होता, या प्रवासाला बास्केटबॉलद्वारे सांस्कृतिक समझोता वाढवण्याचा राजकीय नसलेला प्रयत्न म्हणून समर्थन देत आहेत. स्मिथ यांनी स्पष्ट केले की रॉडमनने 'मित्र' हा शब्द अतिशयोक्तीने वापरला आहे — किम हा फक्त एक ओळखीचा आहे. या गटात 40 लोक होते, ज्यांनी त्यांना राजकारणी किंवा दूत म्हणून न घेता खेळाद्वारे संपर्क निर्माण करायचे असल्याचे सांगितले. परंतु रॉडमन अजूनही आत्मविश्वासाने होते, आणि आलोचकांना या दमनकारी राष्ट्रात खेळाडूंनी भेट देण्यासाठी जी धैर्याची गरज होती ती समजून घेत नसल्याचे सांगितले. 'आम्ही शिक्षा सहन करणार आहोत,' त्यांनी म्हटले. परंतु अनेकांचे म्हणणे आहे की एका अशा देशात जिथे विरोधाला अटक किंवा फाशी देण्यात येते, अशा उपाययोजना अत्याचाराला मान्यता देण्याचा प्रयत्न करतात, त्याच्या विरोधात नाही.

article_content: Camilo Villegas delivered a dazzling eight-under-par 63 to seize the first-round lead at the Wyndham Championship at Sedgefield Country Club in Greensboro, North Carolina. Americans William McGirt and Webb Simpson — the 2011 Wyndham champion — likely believed they had posted a score strong enough to lead after day one, but Villegas had other plans. The Colombian began his round with a birdie on the 10th — his first hole of the day — and followed it with four more birdies and a spectacular eagle on the par-five 5th, completing a bogey-free round. Finishing two shots behind at 65 were England’s Paul Casey, Scotland’s Martin Laird, and American trio Scott Langley, Heath Slocum, and Andrew Loupe. Villegas was thrilled with his performance. 'It was nice to go without bogeys,' he said. 'I think that shows how consistent I was — kept it in the fairway, stayed on the greens, and made the putts when I got close. I just hit the ball nicely.'

article_content: When men attempt DIY around the house, things can sometimes go disastrously wrong. But few cases match the severity of what happened to builder Alan Williams. The 46-year-old was working at his home in Market Drayton, Shropshire, when he slipped at the top of the stairs and accidentally fired a five-inch nail through his left hand. Gruesome as it sounds, the incident left him pinned to the floorboard for nearly four hours, unable to move or call for help. It wasn't until his partner, staff nurse Suzanne Amos, returned home from work around 11 p.m. that he was discovered—shivering and showing signs of shock. Miss Amos had expected a cup of tea and dinner after her shift, but instead found herself dialing 999. 'I slipped at the top of the stairs and put my left hand down,' Mr. Williams said. 'The nail gun in my right hand went off—bang. I was pinned, but surprisingly, there wasn't much blood or pain.' After three hours, his leg began to go numb and he grew extremely cold. 'I was grateful when Suzanne walked through the door,' he added. Miraculously, the high-powered nail passed cleanly through his hand, missing all vital tendons, nerves, and blood vessels. Firefighters had to remove the entire floorboard to transport him to City General Hospital in Stoke-on-Trent. After one hour in surgery, doctors successfully removed the nail. 'The fire chief said he hadn’t seen anything like it in 40 years,' Williams said. 'I ended up going to hospital with a floorboard attached to my hand.' Doctors confirmed he was incredibly fortunate—not a single nerve or vessel was damaged. Miss Amos, who admitted the DIY project was her idea, said: 'He was freezing when I got home. I knew I couldn’t handle this alone—I called 999 immediately.' She added: 'We asked the ambulance team to take us to my hospital—City General, which had just opened its new A&E—and they were fantastic. I work in elderly care, so I never expected to end up in A&E so soon.' Mark Smith, crew manager at Market Drayton Fire Station, explained: 'He was alone and couldn’t reach his phone. The nail was embedded so deeply that removal was impossible without removing the step. He was bandaged with the board still attached.' Thanks to swift action and expert care, Mr. Williams is expected to make a full recovery and return to work with full use of his hand.
translated_content: जेव्हा पुरुष घरी डायवाय करतात, तेव्हा काही वेळा हे दयनीयपणे चुकू शकते. पण बिल्डर अलन विलियम्सच्या घटनेप्रमाणे अशी गंभीरता कधीच झालेली नाही. ४६ वर्षाचा अलन त्याच्या मार्केट ड्रेयटन, श्रॉपशायरमधील घरी काम करत असताना जाड्याच्या टोकापासून सरकला आणि त्याच्या डाव्या हातातून पाच इंचाचा कळी फुटला. हे भयानक वाटले तरी, या घटनेमुळे तो जवळजवळ चार तास फरशीवर चिकटून राहिला, ज्यामुळे तो हालवू शकला नाही किंवा मदतीसाठी फोन करू शकला नाही. त्याची पत्नी, स्टाफ नर्स सुझान एमोस, रात्री अंदाजे ११ वाजता घरी परतल्यावरच त्याला शोधून काढले—तो थरथरत होता आणि शॉकच्या लक्षणे दाखवत होता. एमोस यांनी त्यांच्या शिफ्टनंतर चहा आणि रात्रीचे जेवण मिळवायचे होते, पण त्याऐवजी त्यांनी ९९९ वर फोन केला. 'मी जाड्याच्या टोकापासून सरकलो आणि डावा हात खाली ठेवला,' विलियम्स म्हणाले. 'माझ्या उजव्या हातात असलेल्या कळी गनने ते फुटले—बॅंग! मी चिकटलो होतो, पण आश्चर्याचे विस्तारलेले रक्त नव्हते आणि दुखापतही नव्हती.' तीन तासांनंतर त्याचा पाय बेशुद्ध होऊ लागला आणि तो अतिशय थंड वाटू लागला. 'मी खूप आभारी होतो जेव्हा सुझान दारात आली,' त्याने म्हटले. अद्भुतपणे, उच्च-शक्तीचा कळी त्याच्या हातातून निघून गेला आणि सर्व महत्त्वाचे टेंडन, तंतू आणि रक्तवाहिन्या टाळल्या. अग्निशमन दलाने फरशीचा संपूर्ण तुकडा काढून त्याला स्टोक-ऑन-ट्रेंटमधील सिटी जनरल रुग्णालयात नेले. एक तासाच्या ऑपरेशननंतर, डॉक्टरांनी कळी यशस्वीरित्या काढून टाकली. 'अग्निशमन अधिकाऱ्याने म्हटले की त्यांनी ४० वर्षांत अशी काहीच पाहिले नाही,' विलियम्स म्हणाले. 'मी कळी लावलेल्या फरशीबरोबर रुग्णालयात गेलो.' डॉक्टरांनी पुष्टी केली की तो अतिशय भाग्यवान होता—एकही तंतू किंवा रक्तवाहिनी नुकसान पावलेली नव्हती. एमोस, ज्यांनी डायवाय काम आपल्या विचारात ठेवले होते, म्हणाल्या: 'मी घरी परतले तेव्हा तो थंड होता. मला ठाऊक होते की मी हे स्वतः सामोरे जाऊ शकणार नाही—मी तुरंत ९९९ वर फोन केला.' त्यांनी म्हटले: 'आम्ही अ‍ॅम्ब्युलन्सच्या टीमला माझ्या रुग्णालयाकडे घेऊन जायला सांगितले—सिटी जनरल, जे ताजे ए आणि ई ओपन केले होते—आणि ते अतिशय उत्तम होते. मी रुग्णालयात वृद्ध काळजी विभागात काम करते, त्यामुळे मला अशा लवकर ए आणि ई येणार असल्याचे कधीच वाटले नव्हते.' मार्क स्मिथ, मार्केट ड्रेयटन अग्निशमन स्टेशनचे क्रू मॅनेजर, यांनी स्पष्ट केले: 'तो एकटाच होता आणि त्याच्या मोबाईलवर पोहोचू शकला नाही. कळी इतकी खोल घुसलेली होती की ती काढणे शक्य नव्हते, त्यामुळे फक्त जाड्याचा वरचा टप्पा काढून टाकावा लागला. त्याला बँडेज केले गेले आणि फरशी त्याच्याशी जोडलेली होती.' जलद कृती आणि तज्ञ काळजीमुळे, श्रीमंत विलियम्स यांची पूर्ण बरी होईल आणि त्यांचा हात पूर्णपणे काम करू शकेल.

article_content: Earlier this week, a wheel from the main landing gear of a Colgan Airlines Q400 Bombardier aircraft separated during landing at Buffalo Niagara International Airport. The incident occurred on Flight 3268, which had departed from Newark, New Jersey. A passenger aboard the flight recorded and later shared a video with the Toronto Sun, showing the wheel touching down and rolling away, followed by detached metal components designed to secure it. Despite the dramatic visuals, the aircraft was safely towed to the gate, and all passengers and crew disembarked without incident. Joe Williams, spokesperson for Pinnacle Airlines — Colgan’s parent company — confirmed that no injuries were reported and that no one was ever in danger. He emphasized that the plane had been maintained according to both manufacturer guidelines and FAA regulations. Preliminary findings suggest the detachment resulted from the failure of the outer wheel bearing — a component installed just five weeks prior. While such failures are uncommon, they can occur even with newly installed parts under operational stress. This event has drawn renewed public attention due to its proximity in time and location to the fatal crash of Colgan Air Flight 3407 three months earlier, which claimed 50 lives — including 49 onboard and one person on the ground. Ongoing federal hearings are examining pilot fatigue as a potential contributing factor in that tragedy.

article_content: Renowned psychiatrist Professor Dinesh Bhugra has sparked controversy by questioning whether PTSD is a legitimate medical diagnosis—or simply a product of America’s healthcare economics. He argues that insurance companies and drug makers have pushed the label onto everything from celebrity grief to birth trauma, turning normal emotional responses into diagnosable illnesses. Bhugra, who has never personally assigned a PTSD diagnosis, warns that slapping on this label can actually slow healing by making patients believe they’re permanently broken. He points out that many symptoms labeled as PTSD—like anxiety or insomnia—are already covered under other conditions such as depression or generalized anxiety disorder. When clinicians default to PTSD, he says, patients may receive inappropriate treatments, like talk therapy instead of medication, when the root issue isn't trauma-related. While acknowledging that trauma causes real suffering, Bhugra insists PTSD is a messy catch-all with little scientific precision, save for flashbacks, which remain its only unique marker. Critics, however, push back hard: Dr. Walter Busuttil of Combat Stress, which supports thousands of veterans, says PTSD is vital—it’s the key that unlocks access to proven, trauma-specific therapies. For many soldiers, this diagnosis means getting the right care they wouldn’t otherwise receive. The debate isn’t about whether trauma hurts—but whether naming it PTSD helps or hinders recovery.

article_content: The Centre for Sustainable Development (CSD) will host the Sustainable Leadership Summit in Bengaluru on Saturday, marking its 20th anniversary. The event will formally adopt the 'Bengaluru Declaration on the Acceleration of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).' A. Ravindra, Chairman of CSD and former Chief Secretary of Karnataka, said the declaration will outline a future roadmap for sustainable development, engaging government, industry, NGOs, and youth stakeholders. 'The Sustainability Leadership Summit is the culmination of two decades of work by CSD on critical sustainability issues — water, waste, energy, and the environment,' said Ravindra. 'Today, these challenges, compounded by climate change, directly impact the quality of life.' In preparation for the summit, the first Youth Climate Conclave — a mock Conference of Parties — will be held at BMS Law College on Saturday, featuring six teams from four Indian cities. Winners will be announced at the main summit. CSD has conducted SDG roundtable workshops in four Indian cities — Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, and Bhubaneswar — under the theme 'India’s Sustainability @75: Achievements, Challenges, and Prospects,' commemorating India’s 75th year of independence. Note: The following unrelated business updates were included in the source material but are not part of the summit’s narrative: Apple recorded record quarterly revenue in India; luxury car buyers in India are aging younger; and Punit Goenka’s role in the Sony-Zee merger remains uncertain due to ongoing SEBI investigations.

article_content: In the final hours before her death, Brittany Maynard — a 29-year-old woman battling aggressive brain cancer — experienced a small but terrifying seizure that solidified her resolve to end her life on her own terms. Her husband, Dan Diaz, recounted those moments on The Meredith Vieira Show, explaining that while she had already chosen to use a legally prescribed lethal dose of medication under Oregon’s Death with Dignity Act, the seizure made the reality of her impending decline unmistakably clear. 'It wasn’t just pain,' Diaz said. 'It was the loss of everything that made her her — sight, speech, movement — trapped inside a body that no longer obeyed her.' On the morning of November 1, the day she planned to die, Maynard and Diaz slept in until 9 a.m., then took their two dogs on a peaceful hike near their home. When they returned, she simply knew it was time. Surrounded by loved ones, she passed away peacefully in Diaz’s arms. Her final Facebook message, written hours before, was a tender goodbye: 'The world is a beautiful place... Goodbye world. Spread good energy. Pay it forward.' Though some news outlets had suggested she might have reconsidered — pointing to upbeat videos filmed weeks earlier — Diaz clarified those clips were taken long before her condition worsened. 'She was having seizures daily. Once, she couldn’t speak for four hours. The last one? It broke her. Those videos? They’re ghosts of who she was, not who she became.' Since her death, Diaz has dedicated himself to honoring her legacy by pushing for similar right-to-die legislation across the United States, beginning in California, where they once lived before moving to Oregon so she could access legal aid in dying. 'I don’t want anyone else to suffer like she did — or feel forced to choose between dignity and agony,' he said. 'Letting go isn’t giving up. It’s loving someone enough to honor their choice.' Now on leave from his job in the food industry, Diaz spends his days advocating, speaking publicly, and grappling with silence — especially in the mornings, when he wakes up alone, and at night, when the house is quiet except for the dogs beside him. 'I miss her every second,' he admitted. 'But I also know she wouldn’t want me to stop fighting.'
translated_content: मृत्यूच्या अखेरच्या तासांत, ब्रिटनी मॅयनार्ड — एक 29 वर्षाची महिला जी आक्रमक मेंदू कर्करोगाने ग्रस्त होती — यांनी एक लहान पण भयानक संवेदना अनुभवली ज्यामुळे तिने स्वतःच्या नियमानुसार आयुष्य संपवण्याचा ठराव केला. तिचा पती डॅन डियाझ यांनी मरेडिथ व्हिएरा शोवर हे कथन दिले की, ओरेगॉनच्या मृत्यूच्या इच्छापूर्ती कायद्याअंतर्गत तिने नेहमीच जीवनाच्या अंती औषधांची घातक खुराक घेण्याचा निर्णय घेतला होता, पण त्या दिवशी झालेली लहान संवेदना तिला तिच्या आगामी अवसानाची खरी खरी तथ्ये लक्षात आणली. 'हे फक्त दुःख नव्हते,' डियाझ म्हणाले. 'हे तिच्या तळाशी असलेले सर्व काही गमावण्याचे होते — दृष्टी, बोलणे, हालचाल — तिच्या शरीरात अडकून राहिलेली एक आत्मा जे तिच्या इच्छेनुसार चालले नव्हते.' नोव्हेंबर 1 ला, तिच्या मृत्यूच्या दिवशी, मॅयनार्ड आणि डियाझ नऊ वाजेपर्यंत झोपले, नंतर त्यांनी त्यांचे दोन घरचे कुत्रे घेऊन घराजवळच्या जंगलात फिरण्यास निघाले. घरी परतल्यावर, तिने फक्त जाणले की तिचा वेळ आला आहे. आपल्या आवडत्या मित्रां आणि कुटुंबियांनी घेरलेल्या अवस्थेत तिचे शेवटचे श्वास डियाझच्या बाजूला बसल्यावर थांबले. तिचा शेवटचा फेसबुक संदेश, तिच्या मृत्यूच्या तासांपूर्वी लिहिलेला, एक निवडक विदाई होता: 'जग एक सुंदर ठिकाण आहे... जगा विदाई. चांगली ऊर्जा पसरवा. पुढे द्या!' काही बातम्या अशा विचाराचे निर्माण करीत होत्या की ती शंका करू शकत होती — आधीच तिचे आनंदी व्हिडिओ दाखवून — पण डियाझने स्पष्ट केले की ते व्हिडिओ तिच्या आरोग्याच्या वाढत्या अवस्थेपूर्वीच तयार केले होते. 'तिला दररोज संवेदना होत होत्या. एकदा ती चार तास बोलू शकली नाही. शेवटची संवेदना? ती तिला तोडून टाकली. ते व्हिडिओ? ते तिच्या जीवनाचे भूत आहेत, न की तिच्या वास्तविक अवस्थेचे.' तिच्या मृत्यूनंतर, डियाझने तिच्या वारशाचे आदर करण्यासाठी अमेरिकेतील समान आत्महत्या कायदे लागू करण्याच्या आह्वानास सुरुवात केली, ज्याची सुरुवात कॅलिफोर्नियात झाली, जिथे ते राहिले होते आणि तिच्या निदानानंतर ओरेगॉनला वास्तव्यास गेले होते. 'मी इतर कोणाला तिच्यासारखे दुःख अनुभवू देऊ इच्छित नाही — किंवा गौरव आणि वेदना यांच्यात निवड करावी लागेल असे भासवू देऊ इच्छित नाही,' तो म्हणाला. 'जाणे हे हार मानणे नाही. ते कोणाला इतके प्रेम करणे आहे की त्यांची इच्छा सम्मानित करायची असेल.' आता तो खाद्य उद्योगातील त्याच्या जॉबवरून छोडलेला आहे, डियाझ आपल्या दिवसांची वाटप आह्वानांनी, जाहिरातींनी आणि शांततेच्या वेळी विचार करून करतो — विशेषतः सकाळी, जेव्हा तो एकटा जागा होतो, आणि रात्री, जेव्हा घर शांत असते आणि फक्त कुत्रे त्याच्याजवळ असतात. 'मी तिला प्रत्येक क्षण आठवतो,' तो म्हणाला. 'पण मला ठाऊक आहे की ती मला लढण्याचे थांबवू इच्छित नव्हती.'

article_content: California is enduring one of its most severe droughts in recorded history, prompting officials to take an unprecedented step: cutting off surface water deliveries from the State Water Project for the first time in its 54-year history. This means farmers relying on irrigation for almonds, grapes, and oranges will receive no water this spring — a blow that threatens not only this year’s harvest but also next year’s crop. Since grapevines take 2–30 years to mature, damage to this year’s buds could lead to multi-year losses. The crisis extends beyond farms. Reservoirs like Folsom Lake and Black Butte Lake have plummeted to historic lows, uncovering the remnants of ghost towns drowned decades ago and leaving rural communities with wells running dry. Salmon populations in the American River are collapsing, as upstream releases from Folsom Dam have been drastically reduced. With surface water gone, many farmers are turning to groundwater — but there’s no state regulation on this pumping. Aquifers, already strained from overuse during earlier droughts like 2008–2009, are now dangerously depleted. Experts warn that without adequate time to recharge, these vital underground sources may never recover. California’s $61 billion wine industry faces existential risk. Unlike corn or vegetables, grapevines aren’t replanted yearly. If they die from drought stress, it’s a generational loss. ‘It’s a 30-year commitment,’ explains viticulture professor Mark Matthews. ‘You can’t just wait a year and try again.’ In response, Governor Jerry Brown has urged residents to cut water use by 20%. State officials emphasize that conserving what’s left isn’t just about saving homes — it’s about protecting fish, forests, and future water security. Yet tensions persist between farmers, urban users, and environmentalists. ‘It’s not about picking between fish and farms,’ says Chuck Bonham of the Department of Fish and Wildlife. ‘It’s about making hard choices today to avoid catastrophe tomorrow.’
translated_content: कॅलिफोर्निया एका इतिहासातील सर्वात भयंकर दुष्काळाचा सामना करत आहे, ज्यामुळे अधिकाऱ्यांनी एक अभूतपूर्व पाऊल उचलले आहे: 54 वर्षांच्या इतिहासात पहिल्यांदाच राज्य जल प्रकल्पातून पृष्ठीय पाण्याची वितरणे थांबवली. याचा अर्थ बादाम, द्राक्ष आणि संत्रीसारख्या पिकांसाठी पाणी मिळवणाऱ्या शेतकऱ्यांना हे वसंत काळात कोणतेही पाणी मिळणार नाही — हे या वर्षाच्या उत्पादनासोबतच पुढील वर्षाच्या पिकाला धोका निर्माण करते. द्राक्षाच्या झाडांना 2–30 वर्षे लागतात जेव्हा त्यांना पाकळ्या देण्यासाठी वय घेते, तर या वर्षीच्या कलिकांना नुकसान झाल्यास अनेक वर्षांचे नुकसान होऊ शकते. हा संकट शेतीपलीकडे व्यापलेला आहे. फोल्सम लेक आणि ब्लॅक बट लेक यासारख्या जलाशयांची जलरक्कत ऐतिहासिक पातळीपर्यंत घसरली आहे, ज्यामुळे दशकांपूर्वी पाण्याखाली गेलेल्या भूतगावांचे अवशेष दिसू लागले आहेत आणि ग्रामीण समुदायांना विहिरी वाळून जाण्याचा धोका आहे. अमेरिकन नदीतील सॉमन यांची लोकसंख्या घसरत आहे, कारण फोल्सम डॅममधून वरच्या बाजूला पाणी सोडण्याची जास्तीत जास्त कमी करण्यात आली आहे. पृष्ठीय पाणी नसल्यामुळे, अनेक शेतकरी भूगर्भीय पाण्याकडे वळत आहेत — पण या पंपिंगवर राज्याचा कोणताही नियंत्रण नाही. 2008–2009 या आधीच्या दुष्काळांमध्ये अतिरिक्त वापरामुळे भूगर्भीय जलस्रोत आता धोक्यात आहेत. तज्ञांचे म्हणणे आहे की जर या जलस्रोतांना पुन्हा भरण्यासाठी वेळ मिळाली नाही तर ते कधीही पुन्हा पूर्णपणे बरे होऊ शकत नाहीत. कॅलिफोर्नियाचा 61 अब्ज डॉलरचा वाइन उद्योग अस्तित्वाच्या धोक्यात आहे. तीळ, किंवा भाज्यांसारखे द्राक्षाचे झाड वर्षानुवर्ष रोपटे लावले जात नाहीत. जर ते दुष्काळामुळे मरू लागले तर ते पिढ्यानुपिढ्या नुकसान आहे. 'हे 30 वर्षांचे आहे,' विटिकल्चर प्रोफेसर मार्क मॅथ्यूज म्हणतात. 'तुम्ही फक्त एक वर्ष वाट पाहू शकत नाही आणि पुन्हा प्रयत्न करू शकत नाही.' प्रतिक्रियेत, गव्हर्नर जेरी ब्राउन यांनी राज्यभरातील पाण्याचा वापर 20% कमी करण्याची विनंती केली आहे. राज्याचे अधिकारी म्हणतात की उरलेले पाणी वाचवणे फक्त घरांसाठी नाही, तर फिश, जंगल आणि भविष्यातील पाण्याच्या सुरक्षिततेसाठीही आवश्यक आहे. तरीही शेतकऱ्यां, शहरी वापरकर्त्यां आणि पर्यावरणवाद्यांमध्ये तणाव राहिला आहे. 'हे फिश आणि शेती किंवा लोक आणि पर्यावरण यांच्यात निवड करण्याचे नाही,' असे कॅलिफोर्निया फिश आणि वाइल्डलाइफ विभागाचे डायरेक्टर चक बॉनहॅम म्हणतात. 'हे आजचे कठीण निर्णय घेण्याचे आहे ज्यामुळे उद्या अधिक मोठे नुकसान टाळता येईल.'

article_content: At just 22, Efraim Diveroli has become the center of a major U.S. defense scandal—not as a soldier, but as a young arms dealer whose company, AEY Inc., landed over $200 million in contracts to supply weapons to Afghanistan. The catch? Instead of sourcing ammunition from Hungary as agreed, investigators discovered the shipments contained decades-old, corroded Chinese rounds pulled from Cold War-era stockpiles across Eastern Europe. Diveroli’s family paints a complex picture. His grandfather, Angelo, proudly calls him a 'genius' with weapons, recalling how, as a child, Efraim could name every firearm at gun shows. He insists his grandson is simply fulfilling a 'patriotic' mission overseas—now believed to be in Turkey or Albania. But his father, Michael, laments the path his son chose. 'I wanted him to be a doctor or a lawyer,' he told CNN, describing Efraim as a brilliant but uncontrollable boy genius. Meanwhile, a former business partner, David Packouz, called him 'my former scumbag partner' and accused him of being driven by 'extreme greed.' Public records show Diveroli has faced multiple arrests—including for DUI and possession of stolen property—but no convictions. His 2005 MySpace profile, filled with references to action movies like 'Heat' and 'Scarface,' hinted at a restless, thrill-seeking personality. 'I probably grew up way too fast,' he wrote. 'I definitely have the desire to be very successful in my business.' Though AEY Inc. was once a top government contractor, the scandal has left its reputation in tatters. Diveroli has avoided public comment, and investigators continue probing how such outdated munitions slipped through military oversight.
translated_content: फक्त २२ वर्षाच्या वयात, इफ्रेम डायव्हेरोली हा एक महत्त्वाच्या अमेरिकन रक्षण घोटाळ्याचा केंद्रबिंदू बनला आहे—एक सैनिक म्हणून नव्हे, तर एक तरुण हथियार व्यापारी म्हणून ज्याची कंपनी, एईव्ही इंक, अफगाणिस्तानला हथियारे पुरवण्यासाठी २०० दशलक्ष डॉलरच्या वरील करार केले होते. फरक काय? जरी त्यांनी हंगेरीकडून गोळ्या मिळवायच्या असल्या, तरी तपासणीत अशा जुन्या, जंग लागलेल्या चीनी गोळ्या शोधून मिळाल्या, ज्या पूर्वीच्या सोव्हिएत युगातील भांडारांपासून आणल्या होत्या, जी युरोपच्या पूर्वेकडील देशांमध्ये होत्या. डायव्हेरोलीचे कुटुंब एक जटिल चित्र उपस्थित करते. त्याचे आजोबा, अँजेलो, त्याला हथियारांचा 'जीनियस' म्हणून समजतात, आणि लहान असताना इफ्रेम कसा गन शोमध्ये प्रत्येक बंदूकचे नाव ओळखू शकत होता, याची आठवण करून देतात. ते म्हणतात की त्याचा नातू फक्त एक 'देशभक्तीपूर्ण' मिशन पूर्ण करत आहे—आता तो तुर्की किंवा अल्बेनियामध्ये असल्याचे मानले जाते. पण त्याचे वडील, मायकेल, त्याच्या मार्गाची खेद व्यक्त करतात. 'मी त्याला डॉक्टर किंवा वकील होऊ देऊ इच्छित होतो,' त्यांनी सीएनएनला सांगितले, आणि इफ्रेमला एक बुद्धिमान पण नियंत्रित करणे अशक्य असलेला मुलगा म्हणून वर्णन केले. तर एक जुना व्यापारी साथीदार, डेव्हिड पॅकऊझ, त्याला 'माझा जुना स्कमबॅग पार्टनर' म्हणून संबोधले आणि त्याला 'अतिशय लालच' या गोष्टीने चालवले जात असल्याचे सांगितले. जाहीर नोंदीमध्ये डायव्हेरोलीला अनेक अटका झाल्या आहेत—डीयूआय आणि चोरी केलेल्या मालाच्या अपराधांसह—पण कोणत्याही दोषी ठरविले गेले नाही. त्याचा २००५ चा मायस्पेस प्रोफाइल, ज्यामध्ये 'हीट' आणि 'स्कारफेस' अशा एक्शन चित्रपटांची उल्लेख आहेत, त्याच्या उत्सुक, रोमांचक व्यक्तिमत्त्वाची ओळख करून देतो. article_content: In Shotton, North Wales, 64-year-old Susan Leigh has banned her young great-grandchildren from playing in her garden after trains passing nearby repeatedly sprayed human waste onto her property. The trains, operating on the Wrexham to Bidston line, are outdated models built before 1997 and lack onboard sewage retention tanks — meaning toilet waste is discharged directly onto the tracks, where wind and speed cause it to spray into adjacent homes. Leigh described finding her freshly hung laundry, bedding, and baby clothes covered in waste. She recounted having to don a scarf over her face and plastic bags over her feet to collect and dispose of contaminated items. Her garden, located just 10 feet from the railway, has been repeatedly contaminated, forcing her to bleach surfaces and seal windows. She initially feared the waste might be coming from overhead aircraft until she identified the true source. The situation poses serious health risks, particularly for her two great-grandchildren, aged two and five, and other elderly neighbors. Local councillor Clive Carver called the practice 'disgusting' and demanded urgent intervention, noting that trains often travel at speed along elevated embankments, increasing the risk of widespread contamination. Arriva Trains Wales confirmed that most of its fleet predates 1997 and lacks modern sanitation systems. While Network Rail maintains a contract for regular track cleaning, the company admits the problem persists. Arriva has pledged to retire all non-compliant trains by 2020, after which new models equipped with retention tanks will eliminate the issue entirely. Passengers are urged not to use toilets while trains are stopped at stations. Arriva apologized to affected residents and encouraged them to contact customer relations.
translated_content: शॉटन, उत्तर वेल्समध्ये, 64 वर्षीय सुसन ली यांनी आपल्या लहान मोठ्या नातेवाईकांना आपल्या बागेत खेळण्यापासून बंदी घातली आहे, कारण जवळून जाणाऱ्या ट्रेनींमुळे मानवी अपशिष्टे त्यांच्या संपत्तीवर छापून जात आहेत. ह्या ट्रेनी, व्रेक्शम ते बिडस्टन रेल्वे रेषेवर सेवा देत आहेत, आणि 1997 पूर्वीच्या जुन्या मॉडेलच्या आहेत ज्यांना आतील सीवेज भांडे नाहीत — अर्थात, शौचालयातील अपशिष्टे सरळ रेल्वे ट्रॅकवर सोडली जातात, जेथे वाऱ्याचा वेग आणि ट्रेनचा वेग यामुळे ते जवळच्या घरांमध्ये छापून जातात. ली यांनी त्यांच्या ताज्या धुतलेल्या कपड्यांना, बिस्किटांना आणि बाळांच्या कपड्यांना अपशिष्टांनी ढांकलेले पाहिले. त्यांनी सांगितले की त्यांनी त्यांच्या तोंडावर स्कार्फ आणि पायांवर प्लास्टिकचे बॅग घालून दूषित वस्तू एकत्र करून फेकून द्यावी लागली. त्यांची बाग, रेल्वे रेषेपासून फक्त 10 फूट अंतरावर आहे, आणि अनेकदा दूषित झाली आहे, ज्यामुळे त्यांना पृष्ठभाग धुऊन काढावे लागले आणि खिडक्या बंद कराव्या लागल्या. त्यांनी सुरुवातीला अपशिष्टे विमानांमुळे येत असावीत असे समजले, पण नंतर खरे स्रोत ओळखले. ही स्थिती विशेषतः त्यांच्या दोन मोठ्या नातेवाईकांसाठी, ज्यांची वयोगट 2 आणि 5 आहे, आणि इतर वृद्ध लोकांसाठी गंभीर आरोग्य धोका निर्माण करते. स्थानिक काँसलर क्लाइव्ह कार्व्हर यांनी ह्या प्रथेला 'घृणित' असे म्हटले आणि तात्काळ हस्तक्षेपाची मागणी केली, जेव्हा ट्रेन्स वाढलेल्या खडकावर जलद वेगाने धावत असतात, तेव्हा विस्तृत दूषणाचा धोका वाढतो. अरिव्हा ट्रेन्स वेल्स यांनी त्यांच्या बहुतांशी ट्रेनी 1997 पूर्वीच्या आहेत आणि आधुनिक स्वच्छता प्रणाली नाही असे स्वीकारले. तरीही नेटवर्क रेल, जे रेल्वे बांधणीबाबत जबाबदार आहे, ते नियमित ट्रॅक स्वच्छता करते. अरिव्हा यांनी सर्व अनुपयोगी ट्रेनी 2020 पर्यंत बंद करण्याची खात्री दिली आहे, ज्यानंतर नवीन मॉडेल्स ज्यांना भांडे लावलेले असतील त्यामुळे ट्रॅकवर अपशिष्टे सोडण्याची प्रथा बंद होईल. प्रवासी विनंती केली आहे की ट्रेन निश्चल असताना शौचालय वापरू नये. अरिव्हा यांनी प्रभावित रहिवाशांना क्षमा मागितली आहे आणि त्यांना ग्राहक संबंध विभागाशी संपर्क साधण्याची विनंती केली आहे.

article_content: Fulham are making a £7 million move for Leeds United striker Ross McCormack. The Scotland international remained behind while his teammates departed for their pre-season trip to Santa Cristina, Italy, on Monday. The 27-year-old is set to hold talks once Leeds accept Fulham’s revised bid, although owner Massimo Cellino initially sought £10 million for the player, who scored 28 goals last season. Video: Scroll down to watch Sportsmail’s Top 10 Ross McCormack transfer highlights. In demand: Both Fulham and Norwich City are interested in signing McCormack, the Championship’s top scorer last season. Holding out: Leeds aimed to secure a substantial fee for their leading goalscorer. Norwich are also expected to submit an offer after completing the sale of Robert Snodgrass to Hull City for £7 million. Their primary target remains Blackburn’s Jordan Rhodes, valued at £12 million. Replacement: Norwich view McCormack as a potential replacement for Snodgrass, who has now joined Hull. Running out of options: Paddy Kenny, who appeared out of shape in a pre-season video, is also seeking a new club. West Ham previously showed interest in McCormack but have withdrawn due to the current asking price. Fulham are expected to complete the signing before the end of the week. Leeds goalkeeper Paddy Kenny did not travel to Italy and is actively looking for a new club.

article_content: On Tuesday, India’s Supreme Court will consider a request to relocate the trial of five men accused in the brutal 2012 gang rape and murder of a 23-year-old student — arguing that the intense public outcry in New Delhi makes a fair trial impossible. The attack, which occurred on a moving bus, left the woman critically injured; she passed away two weeks later in a Singapore hospital. Her male companion was also beaten during the assault. One of the accused, Mukesh Singh, claims both police and judges are overwhelmed by public pressure, making impartiality unattainable. His lawyer, Manohar Lal Sharma, confirmed the petition will be heard by Chief Justice Altamas Kabir. Meanwhile, defense attorneys allege their clients were tortured into giving confessions — claims the police have refused to address. A separate legal motion has been filed by attorney A.P. Singh on behalf of Vinay Sharma, requesting a bone-age test to prove his client is under 18. If confirmed, Sharma would be tried as a juvenile, facing a maximum three-year sentence in a reform facility instead of prison or death. Police currently list Sharma’s age as 20, but are also verifying the age of a sixth suspect who claims to be 17. While Indian law mandates closed-door rape trials to protect victims’ identities, defense lawyers are pushing for public hearings — citing transparency as essential. The case, fast-tracked due to national outrage, was adjourned until Thursday, when charges will be formally framed. The accused are expected to plead not guilty. Across India, citizens have demanded tougher penalties, even calling for anyone over 16 to be treated as an adult in such crimes. In response, women and girls are increasingly turning to self-defense training — with events like judo camps in Ahmedabad gaining momentum as symbols of resistance and empowerment.

article_content: Jeremy Paxman has firmly dismissed rumors that he plans to leave Newsnight, following the controversial and botched exposé that falsely implicated Tory peer Lord McAlpine in a child abuse ring. Despite the intense scrutiny and internal turmoil at the BBC, Paxman insisted he will return to the program this Wednesday. However, he declined to confirm whether he intends to stay beyond the immediate future. The 62-year-old presenter, who has hosted Newsnight for 23 years, told the Daily Telegraph: 'I've been away filming, but I will definitely be there on Wednesday.' His comments came after he previously blamed 'cowards and incompetents' for the resignation of BBC Director General George Entwistle, who stepped down over the failed investigation. The Newsnight segment, produced in collaboration with the Bureau of Investigative Journalism, aired unverified claims from former care home resident Steve Messham, leading to widespread online misidentification of Lord McAlpine as a paedophile. The resulting public outcry prompted a full on-air apology from the BBC and a £185,000 compensation settlement for Lord McAlpine. Paxman has been highly critical of BBC management, accusing it of prioritizing political safety over journalistic rigor since the Hutton Inquiry, and of worsening the situation through budget cuts and managerial bloat. Meanwhile, the BBC Trust and acting Director General Tim Davie are evaluating whether Newsnight can continue under its current structure. The Bureau of Investigative Journalism also issued an apology, acknowledging its role in encouraging speculative reporting through a misleading tweet by its managing editor. Legal action is underway against both the BBC and the Bureau by Lord McAlpine, while former Newsnight editor Peter Rippon had already stepped aside over his refusal to air an investigation into Jimmy Savile’s abuses.

article_content: Martin Kaiser, a 54-year-old German hiker, found himself trapped for three hours in a cattle grid while walking his dog along a quiet forest path near the Hochkönig mountain in Austria's Pinzgau region. When his dog suddenly halted at the grid and turned back, Kaiser spun around to call it — and slipped, trapping one leg beneath the metal bars. With pain mounting and circulation at risk, he realized he couldn’t free himself. Facing the possibility of spending the night outdoors, he resorted to yodeling — a centuries-old Alpine vocal technique used to communicate across valleys. His unexpected cry for help was picked up by a passing cyclist, who tried to free him but soon called emergency services. Firefighters arrived and safely extracted him. Though he sustained minor scratches, Kaiser escaped serious injury, received on-site first aid, and continued his hike. Reflecting on the ordeal, he said, 'I’ll definitely watch where I’m stepping next time.'

article_content: PepsiCo has quietly phased out the word 'Natural' from several product lines, replacing it with 'Simply'—even though the ingredients remain unchanged. For instance, its 'Simply Natural' line of Frito-Lay chips is now simply called 'Simply,' and 'Natural Quaker Granola' has been rebranded as 'Simply Quaker Granola.' The company attributes the changes to updated marketing strategies, though they coincide with growing legal scrutiny over the use of the term 'natural.' The FDA does not formally define 'natural' but states it does not object to its use provided the product contains no added color, artificial flavors, or synthetic substances. However, numerous lawsuits have questioned whether products labeled 'natural' truly meet consumer expectations. In 2013, PepsiCo agreed to remove 'all natural' from its Naked Juice labels after it was revealed the drinks contained artificial ingredients, including a fiber derived from Archer Daniels Midland. That same year, PepsiCo discontinued its Gatorade Natural line, citing poor consumer resonance. PepsiCo is not alone in this shift. In 2012, Ben & Jerry's and Breyers altered their packaging to settle lawsuits over claims of 'all natural' ingredients. Campbell Soup also removed 'natural' from its Pepperidge Farm Goldfish packaging after being sued for including genetically modified ingredients—though it claimed the change was purely marketing-driven. Even 'Simply' is not immune to criticism. In 2010, the Center for Science in the Public Interest raised concerns about General Mills’ 'Simply Fruit' product, which contained canola oil and carrot juice—not just fruit. When asked to respond, General Mills spokesperson Mike Siemienas replied via email: 'Yes, we do have a response: It isn't.'
translated_content: पेप्सीकोने काही उत्पादनांवरील 'नॅचरल' हा शब्द धीरे धीरे काढून टाकला आहे आणि त्याऐवजी 'सिम्प्ली' वापरला आहे—जरी साहित्य एकच राहिले असले तरी. उदाहरणार्थ, फ्रिटो-ले चिप्सची 'सिम्प्ली नॅचरल' लाइन आता फक्त 'सिम्प्ली' म्हणून ओळखली जाते, आणि 'नॅचरल क्वाकर ग्रेनोला' चे नाव बदलून 'सिम्प्ली क्वाकर ग्रेनोला' ठेवले आहे. कंपनी हे बदल आपल्या विपणनातील अद्ययावत रणनीतीचा भाग म्हणून सांगते, परंतु ते 'नॅचरल' या शब्दाच्या वापरावर वाढत्या कायदेशीर टीकेशी जुळतात. खाद्य आणि औषध व्यवस्थापन (FDA) याची अधिकृत व्याख्या नाही, परंतु ती म्हणते की जर उत्पादनात कोणतेही जोडलेले रंग, कृत्रिम स्वाद किंवा सिंथेटिक पदार्थ नसतील तर ती 'नॅचरल' शब्दाचा वापर नाकारत नाही. तथापि, अनेक खटले अशा उत्पादनांच्या 'नॅचरल' लेबलच्या वास्तविकतेवर प्रश्न उठवत आहेत. 2013 मध्ये, पेप्सीकोने त्याच्या नेकेड ज्यूसमध्ये कृत्रिम साहित्य, विशेषतः आर्चर डॅनियल्स मिडलँड यांच्याकडून तयार केलेला फायबर असल्याचे आढळल्यानंतर 'ऑल नॅचरल' शब्द काढून टाकले. त्याच वर्षी, पेप्सीकोने त्याचे गॅटोरेड नॅचरल लाइन बंद केले, कारण ते त्याच्या मुख्य ग्राहकांना आवडले नव्हते. पेप्सीको ही एकटी नाही. 2012 मध्ये, बेन अँड जेरीज आणि ब्रेयर्स यांनी 'ऑल नॅचरल' दाव्यांवर झालेल्या खटल्यांचे निकाल लावण्यासाठी त्यांचे पॅकेजिंग बदलले. कॅम्पबेल सूपने त्याच्या पेपरिज फार्म गोल्डफिश क्रॅकर्सवर 'नॅचरल' असे म्हटल्यासाठी खटला दाखल केला, कारण त्यांमध्ये जेनेटिकली मॉडिफाइड घटक होते—परंतु ती म्हणाली की हा बदल फक्त विपणनाचा भाग होता आणि अधिक टिप्पणी करण्यास नकार दिला. अगदी 'सिम्प्ली' हा शब्दही टीकेच्या वरच्या आहे. 2010 मध्ये, सायन्स इन द पब्लिक इंटरेस्ट या संघाने जनरल मिल्सच्या 'सिम्प्ली फ्रूट' उत्पादनावर टीका केली, ज्यामध्ये फक्त फळ नसून कॅनोला तेल आणि गाजरचा रस होता. या टीकेचे उत्तर देण्यास सांगितल्यावर, जनरल मिल्सचे प्रतिनिधी मायक सिमिएनास यांनी ईमेलद्वारे उत्तर दिले: 'होय, आमचे उत्तर आहे: ते नाही.'
