article_content: Shelley Mann, 47, is facing eviction and possible homelessness—even though her ex-husband, David Mann, built his fortune through mining deals. A court-ordered £2 million divorce settlement remains largely unpaid, leaving her with £50,000 in rent arrears and an imminent threat of being forced out of the Belgravia flat where she lives with her two adult daughters. The couple separated in 1997 and divorced in 1999. Shelley was awarded the £1.8 million Hampstead home and regular maintenance payments. When David stopped keeping up the mortgage, she sold the house in 2004—for £1 million less than its current market value. Legal costs drained her savings, forcing her into rentals, eventually moving into a £6,000-per-month mews house in Belgravia that David had been funding. In October 2023, those payments ceased. Without verifiable, consistent income, Shelley cannot secure a new rental. Local authorities may deem her ‘intentionally homeless’ due to the arrears, disqualifying her from public housing support. David, now 49, says he is financially drained and undergoing cancer treatment, residing in a housing association flat and unable to afford adequate care. His lawyer argues the divorce settlement is over 15 years old and that his last substantial income came from a 2013 mining deal. But Shelley’s legal team disputes this, pointing to David’s past ability to pay, his refusal to fully disclose assets, and allegations of submitting questionable medical records. Senior judge Lord Justice MacFarlane voiced deep concern over the damage this prolonged battle has inflicted on the family—particularly the relationship between David and his daughters. He emphasized the urgency of securing stable housing for Shelley and her children, stating that immediate cash relief is essential—not further litigation.
translated_content: शेली मॅन, ४७, तिच्या विधवा पतीच्या बरोबर घराबाहेर पडण्याच्या आशंकेने आहे - जरी तिचा विधवा पती डेव्हिड मॅन खनिज व्यवहारांद्वारे समृद्ध झाला होता. एका न्यायालयीन आदेशानुसार २ मिलियन पौंडचा विवाहविच्छेद निकाल अजूनही पूर्णपणे भरला गेलेला नाही, ज्यामुळे तिच्याकडे बेलग्रेव्हियामधील फ्लॅटवर ५०,००० पौंडचे किराया गुंतवणूक आहे आणि तिला बाहेर काढण्याचा धोका आहे, जिथे ती आपल्या दोन वयोवृद्ध मुलींसह राहते. हे जोडपे १९९७ मध्ये विभक्त झाले आणि १९९९ मध्ये विवाहविच्छेद झाला. शेलीला १.८ मिलियन पौंडचे हॅम्पस्टेड घर आणि नियमित देणगी मिळाली. जेव्हा डेव्हिडने मॉर्गेजची किस्त भरणे बंद केले, तेव्हा तिने २००४ मध्ये घर विकले - आजच्या बाजार मूल्यापेक्षा १ मिलियन पौंड कमी. कायदेशीर खर्चामुळे तिच्याकडे निधी उरले नव्हते, त्यामुळे तिने किरायाने राहण्याचे ठरवले, आणि शेवटी बेलग्रेव्हियामधील ६,००० पौंड प्रति महिना असलेल्या म्यूज घरात राहिली, जे डेव्हिडने भरले होते. ऑक्टोबर २०२३ मध्ये हे भरणे थांबले. नियमित उत्पन्नाचे पुरावे नसल्यामुळे, शेलीला नवीन किरायाचे घर मिळत नाही. स्थानिक अधिकाऱ्यांनी तिला 'इच्छानुसार निराश्रय' म्हणून वर्गीकृत केले जाऊ शकते, ज्यामुळे तिला सार्वजनिक आवास सहाय्यापासून वंचित केले जाईल. डेव्हिड, आता ४९, तो आर्थिकदृष्ट्या निर्धन आहे आणि कर्करोगाचे उपचार घेत आहे, एका आवास संघटनेच्या फ्लॅटमध्ये राहत आहे आणि योग्य उपचार भरून काढण्यास सक्षम नाही. त्याचे वकील असे म्हणतात की विवाहविच्छेद अजूनही १५ वर्षांपूर्वीचा आहे आणि त्याचे शेवटचे मोठे उत्पन्न २०१३ मध्ये आले होते. परंतु शेलीचे कायदेशीर संघटन याचे विरोध करते, डेव्हिडच्या भरण्याच्या इतिहासावर, संपूर्ण आणि ईमानदारीने माहिती देण्याच्या जबाबदारीच्या नियमित उल्लंघनावर आणि अविश्वसनीय औषधी प्रमाणपत्रे देण्यावर भर देते. उच्च न्यायाधीश लॉर्ड जस्टिस मॅकफॅरलेन यांनी ह्या लांब लढ्यामुळे कुटुंबावर झालेल्या नुकसानाबद्दल खूप चिंता व्यक्त केली - विशेषतः डेव्हिड आणि त्याच्या मुलींमधील संबंधांवर. त्यांनी शेली आणि तिच्या मुलींचे आवास सुरक्षित करण्याची तात्काळ गरज व्यक्त केली आणि तात्काळ नाणे आणणे आवश्यक आहे - अधिक न्यायालयीन लढा नव्हे.

article_content: Cherie Blair shared a heartfelt hug and kiss with Martin McGuinness, the former IRA commander, as they departed St Margaret’s Church in Westminster following the funeral of Tony Benn. The scene drew attention not only for its emotional weight but also for its historical resonance. Tony Benn, who served as a Labour MP for over five decades and died at age 88, was remembered by hundreds — including political figures from across the Irish peace process. McGuinness attended alongside Sinn Féin president Gerry Adams, who called Benn 'a friend of Ireland' and credited him with supporting peace. Cherie Blair, present without her husband, also spent time with Benn’s family. Her gesture toward McGuinness echoed a landmark moment in 2012, when Queen Elizabeth II shook hands with him — a profound act of reconciliation 33 years after her cousin, Lord Mountbatten, was killed by an IRA bomb. Prince Philip, the Duke of Edinburgh and Mountbatten’s nephew, also extended his hand despite deep personal loss. Both acts underscored a willingness to move beyond vengeance. McGuinness, who joined the Provisional IRA as a teenager and rose to become its second-in-command in Derry by age 21, admitted his role in the organization but consistently denied ever taking a life. He was convicted in 1973 for possessing explosives and later testified before the Saville Inquiry into Bloody Sunday, where allegations linking him directly to bomb-making were dismissed by him as 'fantasy.' In 2005, Tony Blair met with McGuinness and Adams at Downing Street, acknowledging their pivotal role in peace talks. In his memoirs, Blair wrote: 'Whether you like them or not... they had courage in abundance.' Though controversial, McGuinness’s evolution from paramilitary leader to Northern Ireland’s deputy first minister reflects the complex, often painful path toward peace — one that continues to challenge perceptions of justice, forgiveness, and redemption.
translated_content: चेरी ब्लेयर यांनी टोनी बेनच्या अंत्यसंस्कारानंतर सेंट मार्गरेटच्या चर्चपासून जाताना मार्टिन मॅकगुइनिस, जे पूर्व आयआरए कमांडर होते, यांना एका भावनिक हग आणि चुंबनाने सादर केले. हे दृश्य नफळाच्या भावनिक वजनासहच ऐतिहासिक सामील्यामुळे लक्ष वेधून घेते. टोनी बेन, जे एक लेबर एमपी म्हणून अधिकांश पाच दशके वाहून नेले आणि 88 व्या वयी निधन पावले, त्यांच्या अंत्यसंस्काराला अनेक लोक उपस्थित झाले — त्यात आयर्लंडच्या शांतता प्रक्रियेतील राजकीय नेते समाविष्ट होते. मॅकगुइनिस यांनी सिन फेइनचे अध्यक्ष गेरी एडम्स यांच्यासोबत या सेवेत भाग घेतला, ज्यांनी बेन यांना 'आयर्लंडचे मित्र' म्हणून संबोधले आणि त्यांच्या शांततेला दिलेल्या योगदानाचे आभार मानले. चेरी ब्लेयर, जे त्यांच्या पतीशिवाय होते, त्यांनी बेनच्या कुटुंबाशीही वेळ घालवला. त्यांचे मॅकगुइनिसकडे असलेले वागणूक 2012 मध्ये राणी एलिझाबेथ द्वितीय यांनी त्यांच्याशी हात दिल्यापासून निर्माण झालेल्या ऐतिहासिक क्षणाचे प्रतिबिंब होते — त्यापूर्वी 33 वर्षांनी त्यांचे आत्मीय नातेवाईक, लॉर्ड माउंटबॅटन, आयआरएच्या बॉम्बने मारले गेले होते. दुक ऑफ एडिनबर्ग आणि माउंटबॅटनचे नातेवाईक फिलिप यांनीही खोल वैयक्तिक नुकसानाच्या दरम्यान हात दिला. दोन्ही कृती विनाशापासून आग्रही वाटचाल करण्याची इच्छा दर्शवते. मॅकगुइनिस, जे तरुणावस्थेतच प्रोव्हिजनल आयआरए मध्ये सामील झाले आणि 21 व्या वयी डेरीतील दुसऱ्या कमांडर म्हणून उभे राहिले, त्यांनी संगठनातील भूमिका स्वीकारली पण कधीही कोणाला मारल्याचे नकारले. 1973 मध्ये त्यांना विस्फोटक आणि शस्त्रे असलेल्या कारमध्ये अडकवले गेले आणि सॅविल याचिकेच्या ब्लडी सनडे चौकशीत त्यांनी त्यांच्यावर बॉम्ब बनवण्याचा आरोप 'कल्पना' म्हणून नकारला. 2005 मध्ये, टोनी ब्लेयर यांनी डाऊनिंग स्ट्रीटवर मॅकगुइनिस आणि एडम्स यांची भेट घेतली आणि शांतता बोलचालीत त्यांची महत्त्वाची भूमिका ओळखली. त्यांच्या स्मृतिचित्रात ब्लेयर यांनी लिहिले: 'तुम्हाला त्यांची आवड असो किंवा नसो... त्यांच्याकडे अतिशय धैर्य होते.' अवांछित असले तरी, मॅकगुइनिस यांचे परामर्शी नेते ते उत्तर आयर्लंडचे उपमुख्यमंत्री या पदावर बदल हे शांततेच्या गुंतागुंतीच्या, वेदनादायक मार्गाचे प्रतिबिंब आहे — जे न्याय, क्षमा आणि पुनर्जन्माच्या कल्पनांना आजही आव्हान देत आहे.

article_content: Easter is widely celebrated with symbols of cuteness—bunnies, fluffy chicks, and colorful eggs. While chocolate Easter eggs are a modern invention, vintage cards from the early 1900s reveal a long-standing cultural love for adorable imagery. These cards brim with hand-drawn rabbits, multicolored chickens, rosy-cheeked cherubs, and spring blossoms like daffodils. Many feature non-chocolate eggs, painted or crafted from precious materials. One striking card shows a cherub emerging from an Easter egg—a rare sight on today’s cards. In Australia, where rabbits are considered invasive pests, the Easter Bilby has replaced the bunny since 1968. Made of chocolate and marketed to children, the bilby helps raise awareness for this endangered marsupial. The origins of Easter symbols run deep. The Easter Bunny traces back to Ēostre, a Saxon goddess of spring, while decorated eggs predate Christianity. Archaeologists have found 60,000-year-old painted ostrich eggs in Africa and 5,000-year-old symbolic egg representations in gold and silver from Sumerian and Egyptian tombs. Global Easter traditions vary widely. In Colombia, families enjoy roasted iguana and turtle. In Hungary, women are playfully splashed with water for good luck. In the Czech Republic and Slovakia, a fertility ritual involves gentle whipping with willow branches—believed to enhance beauty and vitality. The hot cross bun, a staple in Britain for over two millennia, is linked to Ēostre. In 1592, London’s Clerk of Markets banned their sale except on Good Friday, Christmas, and funerals—a restriction later upheld by King James I. Despite this, they remain beloved. Superstition holds that kissing the bun before eating brings luck, and sharing one with a friend ensures friendship for the year. Vintage cards from 1890 to 1912 capture these traditions in charming detail—from country scenes with chicks to Bavarian girls enjoying eggs. Though modern designs have simplified, the heart of Easter’s symbolism endures: renewal, joy, and the blending of sacred and seasonal customs. In Greece, red-dyed chicken eggs, often marked with a gold cross, are used by Orthodox Christians to commemorate the resurrection of Christ, continuing traditions from early Christian communities in the Near East.

पासून ईस्टर बिल्बी हा खरड्याचा विकल्प बनला आहे. चॉकलेटमध्ये बनवलेले आणि मुलांसाठी विपणन केलेले, बिल्बी हे विलुप्त होत असलेल्या एका स्थानिक गुराखोराची जाणीव करून देण्यास मदत करते. ईस्टरच्या प्रतीकांचे मूळ खूप जुने आहे. ईस्टर खरडा हा सॅक्सन देवी ईओस्ट्रेशी निगडीत आहे, तर रंगीबेरंगी अंडी ही ख्रिश्चन धर्मापूर्वीच्या काळापासून आहेत. अर्कियोलॉजिस्ट आफ्रिकेमध्ये 60,000 वर्षांच्या रंगीत ओस्ट्रिच अंड्यांच्या शोधांनी आणि सुमेरियन आणि इजिप्शियन गुमास्त्यांमध्ये 5,000 वर्षांच्या सोन्याच्या आणि रूप्याच्या अंड्यांच्या प्रतिमा शोधल्या आहेत. जगभरात ईस्टरच्या सणांचे विविध परंपरा आहेत. कोलंबियामध्ये कुटुंबे उकडलेल्या इग्वाना आणि काच्या खातात. हंगेरियामध्ये, स्त्रियांना शुभ जलाने ओतले जाते. चेक गणराज्य आणि स्लोव्हाकियामध्ये, एक उत्पादन रीत आहे ज्यामध्ये महिलांना झाडाच्या डाळींनी आणि शाखांनी हलवले जाते — ज्यामुळे सौंदर्य आणि उत्पादन वाढते. ब्रिटनमधील हॉट क्रॉस बन हे दोन हजार वर्षांपासून एक अंग आहे, जे ईओस्ट्रेशी निगडीत आहे. 1592 मध्ये लंडनचे क्लर्क ऑफ मार्केट्स यांनी त्यांची विक्री फक्त गुड फ्रायडे, क्रिसमस आणि फनरल्सवरच मर्यादित केली — जी मर्यादा जेम्स आय यांनी नंतर दृढ केली. याच्या विरुद्ध ते आजही लोकप्रिय आहेत. प्राचीन भ्रांती म्हणते की खाण्यापूर्वी बनचे चुंबन घ्यावे जे शुभ आणि मित्रत्वाचे बंधन वाढवते. 1890 ते 1912 च्या व्हिंटेज कार्ड्समध्ये हे परंपरा आकर्षक आणि विस्तृतपणे दाखवले आहेत — बच्च्यांसह देशी दृश्ये ते बावेरियन मुलींच्या ईस्टर अंड्यांच्या आनंदापर्यंत. आधुनिक डिझाइन्स साधे झाले असले तरी, ईस्टरच्या प्रतीकांचे हृदय: पुनर्जन्म, आनंद आणि पवित्र आणि ऋतूच्या संस्कृतीचे विलय. ग्रीसमध्ये, लाल रंगीत चिकन अंडी, वारंवार सोन्याच्या क्रॉसने दाखवलेले, ईस्टरच्या निर्माणाचे स्मरण करतात आणि प्राचीन निकट पूर्व ख्रिश्चन समुदायांच्या परंपरा जपतात.

article_content: EU officials have proposed allowing meat and milk from the offspring of cloned farm animals to be sold in supermarkets without mandatory labeling — a move that would leave consumers unaware of what they are eating. The proposal, unveiled today, has drawn sharp criticism from consumer advocacy groups. While the idea of cloning animals for food may sound like science fiction, evidence suggests that products from cloned animal offspring are already entering European markets via imports from the United States, Argentina, and Brazil. In 2008, a Scottish farmer imported two bulls — sons of a cloned animal — and bred 92 Holstein dairy cows from them. Initially planning to sell the milk domestically, he reversed course after public outcry, destroying over 40 cows and exporting roughly 30 to Portugal. Animal cloning has been linked to serious health complications, including high rates of miscarriage, organ malformations, and 'gigantism' — where newborns are so large they require Caesarean delivery. The original clone, Dolly the Sheep, developed premature arthritis, raising further concerns. In 2008, the European Group on Ethics in Science and New Technologies concluded that animal cloning for food cannot be ethically justified given the current levels of suffering and health risks. UK research by the Food Standards Agency found that the vast majority of consumers oppose cloning for food production, citing both animal welfare and potential human health impacts. Most insist any food derived from clones or their offspring must be clearly labeled. Under the new European Commission proposal, food from cloned animals themselves would be banned, but products from their naturally bred offspring would face no restrictions — creating a significant regulatory gap. BEUC, the European consumer body, condemned the lack of labeling requirements. Director General Monique Goyens stated: 'If Europe opens the floodgates to meat from clone offspring, the least it can do is let consumers choose through clear labeling.' A staggering 83% of European consumers have expressed opposition to consuming such products. With widespread public resistance and no traceability systems in place in export countries, critics ask: Why is this debate still ongoing?

ग्राहकांना त्यांच्या खाण्याची खरी माहिती देणार नाही. आज जाहीर केलेला हा प्रस्ताव ग्राहक संघटनांनी निषेध केला आहे. प्राण्यांचे प्रतिकृतीकरण खाद्य उत्पादनासाठी करणे हे विज्ञान कथेसारखे वाटू शकते, परंतु अमेरिका, आर्जेंटिना आणि ब्राझिल येथून आयात केलेल्या उत्पादनांमध्ये प्रतिकृतीकरणाद्वारे तयार झालेल्या प्राण्यांच्या मुलांचे मांस आणि दूध आधीपासूनच युरोपियन बाजारात आले आहे. 2008 मध्ये, एका स्कॉटिश शेतकऱ्याने दोन बैल आयात केले — जे एका प्रतिकृतीकरणाद्वारे तयार झालेल्या प्राण्याचे मुलगे होते — आणि त्यांच्यापासून 92 होल्स्टीन दुग्धदायी गायींची पिढी तयार केली. आरंभी त्याने दूध स्थानिक बाजारात विकण्याची योजना बनवली होती, परंतु ग्राहकांच्या प्रतिक्रियेमुळे त्याने 40 पेक्षा जास्त गायींचा नाश केला आणि जवळपास 30 गायी पोर्तुगालमध्ये नेल्या. प्राण्यांचे प्रतिकृतीकरण अतिशय आरोग्य समस्यांशी निगडित आहे, ज्यामध्ये गर्भपाताचे प्रमाण जास्त, अवयवांची विकृती आणि 'अतिमानवी आकार' — ज्यामध्ये नवजात बाळे इतकी मोठी असतात की त्यांना सीझेरियन ऑपरेशनने काढावे लागते. पहिली प्रतिकृती, डॉली दि शीप, याला लवकर आर्थ्राइटिस झाला, ज्यामुळे अधिक चिंता निर्माण झाली. 2008 मध्ये, विज्ञान आणि नवीन तंत्रज्ञानासाठी युरोपियन नैतिकता समूहाने निष्कर्ष काढला की, खाद्य उत्पादनासाठी प्राण्यांचे प्रतिकृतीकरण वर्तमान स्थितीत नैतिकदृष्ट्या उचित नाही, कारण त्यामुळे होणारा दुःख आणि आरोग्य समस्या अतिशय जास्त आहेत. ब्रिटनच्या फूड स्टँडर्ड्स एजन्सी (FSA) च्या संशोधनानुसार, ग्राहकांच्या बहुमताने प्राण्यांचे प्रतिकृतीकरण खाद्य उत्पादनासाठी करण्याला विरोध केला आहे, ज्यामध्ये प्राण्यांच्या कल्याणाची आणि मानवी आरोग्याची चिंता आहे. बहुतेक लोक असे म्हणतात की प्रतिकृतीकरणाद्वारे किंवा त्यांच्या मुलांद्वारे तयार झालेले खाद्य पदार्थ स्पष्टपणे लेबल केले जावे. युरोपियन कमिशनच्या नवीन प्रस्तावानुसार, प्रतिकृतीकरणाद्वारे तयार झालेल्या प्राण्यांचे खाद्य बंदी लागेल, परंतु त्यांच्या नैसर्गिकपणे जन्मलेल्या मुलांचे खाद्य यावर कोणतेही नियंत्रण लागणार नाही — ज्यामुळे महत्त्वाचा नियमन रिक्त स्थान निर्माण होईल. युरोपियन ग्राहक संघटना BEUC ने लेबलिंगची आवश्यकता न घेण्याची निंदा केली. डायरेक्टर जनरल मोनिक गोयेन्स यांनी म्हटले: 'जर युरोप प्रतिकृतीकरणाद्वारे तयार झालेल्या मुलांच्या मांसासाठी दरवाजे उघडला, तर ग्राहकांना निवड देण्यासाठी अशा खाद्य पदार्थांचे लेबल देणे हे त्यांचे लहानसे कर्तव्य आहे.' एक आश्चर्यकारक 83 टक्के युरोपियन ग्राहकांनी अशा उत्पादनांचे सेवन करण्याला विरोध केला आहे. आयात करणाऱ्या देशांमध्ये अशा खाद्यांची अनुसरण करण्याची प्रणाली नसल्यामुळे आणि जास्तीत जास्त ग्राहकांचा विरोध असल्यामुळे, टीकाकार article_content: In the coastal village of Navotas, north of Manila, a man clings to the broken remains of his home, salvaging what little he can after Typhoon Nesat tore through the region. While his house is gone, he’s among the fortunate—many of his neighbors lost everything entirely. Nesat, packing winds over 120 mph and torrential rains, unleashed the worst flooding in decades across the northern Philippines, killing at least 41 people and leaving 45 others unaccounted for. Nearly half a million Filipinos were impacted, with around 170,000 forced into evacuation centers. In towns like Jaen, residents are still stranded on rooftops, waiting for help that’s slow to arrive due to a shortage of boats and impassable roads. Emergency crews are working tirelessly, pulling children from floodwaters and delivering supplies where they can. Meanwhile, the storm’s path shifted toward southern China, where it made landfall on Hainan Island, knocking out power, grounding flights, and closing schools—but no fatalities have been reported there. Hong Kong, though spared a direct hit, saw its streets go silent as businesses shuttered, the stock exchange halted trading, and 245 flights were delayed or diverted. Two people were injured when scaffolding collapsed onto a taxi, and another was hurt by a falling tree. A barge broke loose and crashed into a seawall, prompting evacuations nearby. Even as waters begin to recede in some areas, the threat isn’t over: Tropical Storm Nalgae is forming farther east, already packing 52 mph sustained winds and expected to intensify before striking the Philippines again within days. The region now braces for a dangerous double punch.

article_content: For more than a decade after the Taliban banned movies, destroyed TVs, and even obliterated ancient statues like the Buddhas of Bamiyan, Afghanistan’s film industry lay in ruins. But now, a new generation of Afghan filmmakers is using cinema to tell raw, honest stories about life in their war-torn capital. The film 'Kabul, I Love You'—a collection of ten interconnected short stories—isn’t just a movie; it’s a heartfelt portrait of resilience, painted with the brushstrokes of everyday suffering and quiet courage. Produced with support from the United Nations mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA), the project aimed not to preach, but to listen—to let Afghan voices speak for themselves. Filmmakers tackled urgent issues like forced marriages, land mines, illegal land seizures, and ethnic tensions, all within tight budgets and dangerous conditions. Of the 200 applicants, 11 were chosen to direct segments. Two of them vanished after receiving funding—one disappeared with $8,000, another fled to Iran after threats. Yet the rest stayed, and finished filming. When the movie premiered at a cultural center in Kabul in May 2012, audiences responded with warmth and emotion. Not every story shone: some suffered from stiff acting, slow pacing, or overly dramatic dialogue. But one segment—'Virgin Towers,' directed by Farhad Razae—left critics moved. It tells the haunting tale of a young woman fleeing her family to avoid being forced into marriage with a relative. Wearing a burqa, she runs through the streets, her breathing heavy, her world narrowed by fabric and fear. The scene is silent yet deafening. Razae drew from his own past: as a young man tending a mosque, he noticed a girl who lingered after prayers. He wondered about her pain but stayed silent, bound by shame and tradition. His film gives voice to that silence. Veteran filmmaker Malek Shafi'i praised Razae for capturing Afghan truth better than most. 'He didn’t invent drama—he found it in real life,' Shafi'i said. In recent years, even in one of the world’s most conservative societies, artists have begun testing limits. People are learning that creativity won’t get them killed—at least not always. As NATO prepares to withdraw by the end of 2014, the future remains uncertain. But 'Kabul, I Love You' stands as proof: even in rubble, beauty can still be made—and seen.
translated_content: तलिबानने चित्रपट बंद केले, टीव्ही नष्ट केले आणि बामियनचे महान बुद्ध प्रतिमे नष्ट केल्यानंतर अधिक एक दशकांनंतर, अफगाणिस्तानचा चित्रपट उद्योग नष्ट झाला होता. पण आता, एक नवीन पिढीचे अफगाण चित्रपट निर्माते युद्धात जखमी राजधानीतील जीवनाची कठोर, सत्य कथा सांगण्यासाठी चित्रपटांचा वापर करत आहेत. 'काबूल, मी तुला आवडते' हा दहा एकत्रित लहान कथा असलेला चित्रपट फक्त एक चित्रपट नाही—तो रोजच्या दुःखांच्या आणि शांत धैर्याच्या ब्रशस्ट्रोक्सने रचलेला एक आध्यात्मिक आत्मबलाचा चित्र आहे. अफगाणिस्तानातील संयुक्त राष्ट्रांच्या मिशन (UNAMA) च्या सहाय्याने तयार केलेला हा प्रकल्प शिकवण्याऐवजी ऐकण्यासाठी होता—अफगाण आवाजांना स्वतःचे सांगण्यासाठी. चित्रपट निर्मात्यांनी अनिवार्य लग्ने, भूमी खनी, अवैध जमीन हस्तांतरण आणि जातीय तणाव यासारख्या गंभीर समस्या लहान बजेट आणि धोकादायक परिस्थितीत सांगितल्या. 200 अर्जदारांपैकी 11 ला भाग दिले गेले. त्यापैकी दोघांनी फंड मिळवल्यानंतर देश सोडला—एकाने 8,000 डॉलर घेऊन गेले, दुसरा धमक्यांमुळे इराणला पळाला. पण उरलेल्यांनी राहून चित्रपट तयार केला. मे 2012 मध्ये काबूलमधील एका सांस्कृतिक केंद्रात चित्रपटाचे प्रदर्शन झाले तेव्हा प्रेक्षकांनी आनंदाने प्रतिक्रिया दिली. सर्व कथा सुंदर नव्हत्या: काहींमध्ये अतिशय नाटकीय अभिनय, धीमी गती आणि अतिशयोक्तीची भाषा होती. पण फरहाद रझई यांनी दिलेला एक भाग—'वर्जिन टॉवर्स'—ने विमर्शकांना भावुक केले. ही कथा एका तरुणीची आहे जी आपल्या कुटुंबापासून वाचण्यासाठी आपल्या नातेवाईकाशी लग्न करू नये अशी भावना घेऊन पळते. बुर्का घालून ती रस्त्यांवर धावते, तिचे श्वास भारी आहेत, आणि तिचा दृष्टीक्षेत्र फॅब्रिकने आवरलेला आहे. हा दृश्य शांत आहे पण खूप आवाजाचा. रझईने आपल्या अतीतापासून प्रेरणा घेतली: तरुण वयात एका मशिदीचे रखरखीत असताना, त्याला एक तरुणी दिसली जी नमाज झाल्यानंतर दोन तास तेथे राहात होती. त्याला तिची वेदना कळायची होती, पण तो लज्जेने आणि धर्माच्या नियमांमुळे विचारू शकला नाही. त्याचा चित्रपट त्या शांततेला आवाज देतो. अनुभवी चित्रपट निर्माते मालेक शफीई यांनी रझईचे अतिशय प्रशंसा केले. 'त्याने नाटक निर्माण केले नाही—तो ते खरोखरच आढळून आणले,' शफीई म्हणाले. शेवटच्या पाच वर्षांत, जगातील सर्वात अतिशय संरक्षित समाजातही, कलाकारांनी सीमा ओलांडण्याचा प्रयत्न केला आहे. लोकांना जाणवले आहे की, जर ते सीमा ओलांडले, तर त्यांना काहीही घडणार नाही—किमान नेहमीच नाही. 2014 च्या शेवटी नाटो अफगाणिस्तान सोडणार आहे, आणि त्यांनी सोडलेली अस्थिर सुरक्षितता कलाकृतींच्या विकासासाठी आशावादी नाही. पण 'काबूल, मी तुला आवडते' हा सिद्धांत आहे: राखेतही सौंदर्य निर्माण केले जाऊ शकते—आणि पाहिले जाऊ शकते.

article_content: When Nick Grimshaw took over the Radio 1 breakfast slot from longtime host Chris Moyles in September 2012, many expected a smooth transition. Instead, the show faced a turbulent start marked by public backlash. Grimshaw’s off-air antics—like partying with stars such as Harry Styles and Pixie Geldof just before dawn broadcasts—and his use of explicit language on social media sparked outrage among parents, who accused him of being a bad influence on teens. An online petition demanding his removal gained traction, highlighting concerns about his suitability as a public figure for young audiences. Meanwhile, across the dial, Chris Evans’s breakfast program on Radio 2 surged in popularity. With nearly 9.5 million weekly listeners, Evans’s show not only outperformed Grimshaw’s 6.7 million but also beat the BBC’s prestigious Today programme. Many former Radio 1 loyalists—particularly middle-aged men who missed Moyles’s style—switched to Evans’s more polished, veteran-hosted format. The shift was so pronounced that Evans’s audience grew by a full million compared to the prior quarter, nearing his own 2010 peak of 9.53 million. Despite the ratings dip, BBC Radio 1 celebrated a quieter victory: the average age of its listeners fell from 33 to 32, thanks to 250,000 new listeners aged 15–24 drawn to Grimshaw’s edgier tone. While the overall numbers declined slightly—down 43,000 from the previous quarter and half a million from the same time last year—the station’s leadership viewed this as a strategic win. Controller Ben Cooper stated the changes had exceeded expectations, calling it the most significant schedule overhaul in a generation. Elsewhere, the BBC’s audio landscape strengthened. Radio 6 Music, once slated for cancellation, gained nearly half a million new listeners, buoyed by fan protests two years earlier. Meanwhile, total UK radio listenership climbed to over 47 million—a record high—and DAB radio ownership surpassed 40%, now held by 42% of adults. Bob Shennan, who oversees both Radio 2 and Radio 6 Music, called Evans’s show the 'lynchpin' of the network’s success, praising its stability and appeal.

अपेक्षित होते. परंतु, शोने जनतेच्या विरोधाने एक अस्थिर सुरुवात केली. ग्रिमशॉचे बाहेरचे वर्तन—जसे की हॅरी स्टाइल्स आणि पिक्सी गेल्डॉफ यांसारख्या तारांसोबत दिवसभराच्या आधीच्या वेळी भेटवेळ घालवणे—आणि सामाजिक माध्यमांवर अश्लील भाषेचा वापर यामुळे आईवडिलांच्या ओढ्याला उत्तेजन झाले, ज्यांनी त्याला तरुण प्रशंसकांसाठी खालचा आदर्श मानले. त्याचे निलंबन मागणारी ऑनलाइन पेटिशन लोकप्रिय झाली, ज्यामुळे त्याच्या युवा श्रोत्यांसाठी योग्यतेविषयी चिंता व्यक्त झाली. त्याच वेळी, रेडिओ २ वर क्रिस एव्हन्सच्या ब्रेकफास्ट प्रोग्रामची लोकप्रियता वाढली. जवळपास 9.5 मिलियन आठवड्याच्या श्रोत्यांसह, एव्हन्सचा शो ग्रिमशॉच्या 6.7 मिलियन श्रोत्यांना ओलांडला आणि बीबीसीच्या प्रसिद्ध टुडे प्रोग्रामला देखील पार केला. ज्या रेडिओ १ चे जुने श्रोते—खास करून मध्यम वयोगटाचे पुरुष जे मॉयल्सच्या शैलीला आवडत होते—ते एव्हन्सच्या अधिक नियमित आणि अनुभवी होस्टच्या फॉरमॅटकडे वळले. हे वळण इतके स्पष्ट होते की एव्हन्सचे श्रोते गेल्या तिमाहीपेक्षा एक मिलियनने वाढले आणि 2010 मध्ये त्याच्या पहिल्या तिमाहीतील 9.53 मिलियन श्रोत्यांच्या नोंदीजवळ पोहोचले. रेटिंग्जच्या घटीच्या विरुद्ध, रेडिओ १ ने एक शांत विजय साजरा केला: त्याच्या श्रोत्यांची सरासरी वय 33 ते 32 वर घसरली, जे ग्रिमशॉच्या तीव्र टोनमुळे 2,50,000 नवीन श्रोते आकर्षित करून झाले. एकूण संख्या थोडी घटली—गेल्या तिमाहीपेक्षा 43,000 ने आणि एका वर्षापूर्वीच्या तिमाहीपेक्षा 5,50,000 ने—परंतु स्टेशनच्या नेतृत्वाने हे एक रणनीतिक विजय म्हणून पाहिले. रेडिओ १ चे कंट्रोलर बेन कूपर यांनी म्हटले की बदलांनी त्यांच्या अपेक्षांपेक्षा जास्त गोष्ट घडवून आणली आहे, आणि हे पिढीभरातील सर्वात मोठे शेड्यूल बदल आहे. इतर बाबतीत, बीबीसीचा ऑडिओ वातावरण बळकट झाले. रेडिओ ६ article_content: A 13-year-old boy told authorities he knew professional wrestling on TV was scripted, but his account of repeatedly punching, jumping on, and slamming his 5-year-old half-sister onto a bed was horrifyingly real — and fatal. Viloude Louis, 5, of Terrytown, Louisiana, was found unresponsive on a bathroom floor Sunday. She was rushed to a hospital, where she was pronounced dead. The boy, whose name has not been released due to his age, has been charged with second-degree murder and remains detained at the Rivarde Juvenile Detention Center. Sheriff’s Col. John Fortunato told CNN the boy 'was smiling and appeared to take great pride in what he was doing' during questioning, showing no remorse in front of his mother. Authorities say the mother left the two children alone at home while she went to the store. Initially, the boy claimed he found Viloude lying in the bathroom with a stomachache, then laid her on the sofa and called 911 after noticing she wasn’t breathing. But a follow-up interview revealed a chillingly different story: the boy admitted to punching Viloude in the stomach multiple times, slamming her onto the bed, jumping on her, and striking her with his elbow — mimicking moves he had seen on WWE television. He said Viloude cried out in pain, yet he continued for two to three more minutes until his mother called to check on them. The coroner’s external exam found no visible trauma, but an autopsy later revealed severe blunt-force injuries: multiple broken ribs, a lacerated liver, and extensive internal bleeding. WWE issued a statement calling the death a tragedy and firmly rejecting any link to their entertainment product. 'It is illogical to conclude that the repeated, brutal, and ultimately fatal beating of a 5-year-old girl could be confused with imitation of WWE action,' the company said. The Jefferson Parish District Attorney’s Office declined to comment, citing the suspect’s minority status. The mother will not face criminal charges, according to Sheriff’s officials.

article_content: For six harrowing weeks, Craig Kinsella was trapped in a Sheffield garage, forced to work from dawn till midnight without pay, eat scraps from trash bins, and use a bucket as a toilet—all while enduring brutal beatings from the family who claimed to care for him. David Rooke, 44, his wife Donna, 40, and their 19-year-old son Jamie subjected Kinsella to relentless violence, treating him not as a human, but as a punching bag. CCTV footage showed David choking him, kicking him while he cowered, and striking him with tools like pickaxes and crowbars. The abuse came to light in July last year after police responded to a neighbor’s report of Jamie threatening someone with a knife—and found Kinsella severely injured, emaciated, and too terrified to speak up at first. He later revealed he’d been manipulated for years: his disability benefits were stolen, his flat abandoned, and his freedom erased. At sentencing, Judge Peter Kelson QC called the ordeal 'staggering' and 'almost unbelievable' in modern Britain, condemning the Rookes for crushing Kinsella’s spirit. David received six-and-a-half years in prison, Jamie four years, and Donna four months. The judge ordered David to pay £15,000 in compensation—a fraction of the trauma inflicted. Authorities say Kinsella is still recovering physically and mentally, and fear many others like him remain hidden in plain sight.

article_content: By Jill Reilly. PUBLISHED: 06:49 EST, 31 December 2013. | UPDATED: 14:05 EST, 31 December 2013. 'Twerking'—a sexually provocative dance style—gained widespread attention after Miley Cyrus’s performance at the MTV Video Music Awards. Lake Superior State University has released its annual list of overused and annoying words, and those flexible enough to take selfies while twerking should take note. In addition to 'selfie' and 'twerking,' nominees strongly felt that the terms 'hashtag' and 'Mr. Mom' have outlived their usefulness. 'Selfie'—a term for a self-taken photo, often captured with a smartphone—led the list among more than 2,000 nominations submitted for the university’s 39th annual Banished Words List, which targets words overused, misused, or fatigued by repetition. Even President Barack Obama joined the trend this month, taking a widely publicized selfie with world leaders at Nelson Mandela’s memorial service in South Africa. 'It's a lame word. It's all about me, me, me,' wrote David Kriege of Lake Mills, Wisconsin. 'Put the smartphone away. Nobody cares about you.' Since 1975, the university’s list has grown to include over 800 words drawn from politics, sports, and popular—and sometimes overly popular—culture. 'The list is made up entirely of nominations. We don’t just sit around thinking of words that bug us,' said Tom Pink, a university spokesperson based in Sault Ste. Marie, Michigan’s Upper Peninsula. 'Twerking' gained prominence due to Miley Cyrus’s MTV performance. President Obama further fueled its visibility with his selfie at Mandela’s memorial. 'Time to dance this one off the stage,' said Jim Connelly of Flagstaff, Arizona. 'Hashtag' refers to a word or phrase preceded by the # symbol on Twitter. Other banned terms include 'Twittersphere,' 't-bone,' 'Obamacare,' 'intellectually/morally bankrupt,' and anything 'on steroids.' 'Mr. Mom'—a term referencing fathers who care for children—also made the list. It’s also the title of a 1983 comedy starring Michael Keaton, though many modern stay-at-home dads reject the stereotype of the bumbling male caregiver. 'There were nearly as many nominations for 'Mr. Mom' as for 'selfie' and 'twerking,''' Pink noted. The term 'hashtag' also made the list, with critics arguing it has become redundant in digital communication. Pink believes renewed attention came from media coverage of the 30th anniversary of the film. 'The phrase should refer only to the film, not to men in real life,' wrote Pat Byrnes of Chicago. 'It’s an insult to the millions of dads who are primary caregivers for their children. Would we tolerate calling working women 'Mrs. Dad'?' Terms like '-pocalypse' and '-ageddon'—used to inflate words like 'snow-pocalypse' or 'ice-ageddon'—were also flagged as overused. 'Adversity' and 'fan base'—commonly used in sports reporting—drew criticism. Kyle Melton of White Lake, Michigan, argued for perspective: 'Facing adversity is working 50 hours a week and still struggling to feed your kids.'

article_content: Mexico’s path to the World Cup was far from easy—they scraped through qualifying by just beating Panama on the final day, then edged out New Zealand in a playoff. But after a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Cameroon, thanks to Oribe Peralta’s goal in rainy conditions in Natal, the team is riding high. Manager Miguel Herrera isn’t content with just three points—he’s already dreaming big: beating host nation Brazil. Despite Giovani dos Santos being unfairly denied two clear goals by the assistant referee’s offside flag, Mexico stayed composed, dominated possession, and seized their moment. The fans in Natal created an electric atmosphere, waving flags and chanting nonstop. Herrera commended his players’ resilience: 'We knew the refs might make mistakes, but we kept our heads and got the result we needed.' On the other side, Cameroon, still recovering from a bitter bonus dispute and lacking sharpness, struggled to create real chances. Coach Volker Finke admitted disappointment but vowed to fight for a win against Croatia. With confidence soaring and momentum building, Mexico isn’t just heading to Fortaleza—they’re heading there to make history.

article_content: DENVER, Colorado (CNN) — Former Virginia Governor Mark Warner told the Democratic National Convention that the most important race facing the country is the 'race for the future' — and it won’t be won by a president stuck in the past. 'This election is about the future versus the past,' Warner said Tuesday. 'We need a president who understands the world today, the future we seek, and the change we need. We need Barack Obama as the next president of the United States.' Warner delivered the keynote address at the convention — the same slot Barack Obama filled four years earlier. He criticized President Bush for a failure of leadership during a critical moment in the nation’s history. 'Folks always ask me: What’s my biggest criticism of President Bush? I’m sure you all have your own. Here’s mine: It’s not just the policy differences. It’s that this president never tapped into our greatest resource — the character and resolve of the American people. He never truly asked us to step up.' Warner said John McCain offered only 'a plan that would explode the deficit and leave it to our children — no real strategy to invest in infrastructure, and continuing to spend $10 billion a month in Iraq. I don’t know about you, but that’s just not right. That’s four more years we simply can’t afford.' But much of his speech focused on the bipartisan rhetoric Obama has championed on the campaign trail. 'I know we’re at the Democratic Convention, but if an idea works, it doesn’t matter whether it carries a 'D' or an 'R.' This election isn’t about liberal versus conservative or left versus right. It’s about the future versus the past.' 'That’s why we must elect Barack Obama as our next president,' Warner said. 'Because the race for the future will be won when old partisanship gives way to new ideas — when we choose solutions over stalemates, and hope over fear.'
translated_content: डेनव्हर, कोलोराडो (सीएनएन) — व्हर्जिनियाचे तत्कालीन राज्यपाल मार्क वॉर्नर यांनी डेमोक्रॅटिक नॅशनल कॉन्व्हेन्शनवर सांगितले की देशासमोरची सर्वात महत्त्वाची स्पर्धा म्हणजे 'भविष्यासाठीची स्पर्धा' — आणि ही स्पर्धा ज्या अध्यक्षाने गेल्या काळात अडकलेले आहेत, त्यांच्यामुळे जिंकली जाणार नाही. 'ही निवडणूक म्हणजे भविष्य आणि गेल्या काळाची लढाई,' वॉर्नर यांनी बुधवारी सांगितले. 'आम्हाला आजच्या जगाचे, आमच्या इच्छित भविष्याचे आणि आम्हाला गरज असलेल्या बदलाचे ज्ञान असलेला अध्यक्ष हवा आहे. आम्हाला अमेरिकेचे पुढील अध्यक्ष म्हणून बराक ओबामा हवे आहेत.' वॉर्नर यांनी कॉन्व्हेन्शनवर मुख्य भाषण दिले — चार वर्षांपूर्वी ओबामा यांनी हा तिसरा वेळ घेतला होता. त्यांनी राष्ट्राच्या ऐतिहासिक क्षणात अध्यक्ष बुश यांच्यावर नेतृत्वाच्या अपयशाचा आरोप केला. 'लोक नेहमी विचारतात: बुश अध्यक्षाबद्दल तुमचा सर्वात मोठा आरोप काय आहे? मी खात्रीने जाणतो की तुम्हाला तुमचे स्वतःचे आहेत. माझा आरोप असा आहे: फक्त धोरणातील फरक नाही. तर हे की हा अध्यक्ष कधीच आमच्या सर्वात मोठ्या संसाधनांना — अमेरिकन लोकांच्या वैशिष्ट्य आणि दृढतेला — वापरले नाही. त्यांनी आम्हाला उभे राहायला विचारले नाही.' वॉर्नर यांनी म्हटले की जॉन मॅकेन यांनी फक्त 'अशी योजना दिली आहे जी आर्थिक आधीन वाढवेल आणि ते आमच्या मुलांना सोपवेल — आमच्या बांधकामात गुंतवणूक करण्यासाठी कोणतीही खरी रणनीती नाही, आणि इराकमध्ये प्रत्येक महिन्याला 10 अब्ज डॉलर खर्च करणे चालू ठेवेल. मला माहित नाही तुम्हाला काय वाटते, पण हे फारच योग्य नाही. हे चार वर्ष आम्ही फारच व्यय करू शकत नाही.' पण त्यांच्या भाषणाचा बहुतांश भाग ओबामा यांच्या निवडणूक अभियानातील दलगत भाषणावर होता. 'मी जाणतो की आम्ही डेमोक्रॅटिक कॉन्व्हेन्शनवर आहोत, पण जर एखादी विचार कार्यक्षम असेल, तर त्याला 'डी' किंवा 'आर' लावलेले असले तरी फरक पडत नाही. कारण ही निवडणूक उदारवादी आणि संरक्षकवादीची नाही. ती डावी आणि उजवीची नाही. ती भविष्य आणि गेल्या काळाची आहे.' 'म्हणूनच आम्हाला बराक ओबामा यांना आमचे पुढील अध्यक्ष म्हणून निवडायला हवे,' वॉर्नर म्हणाले. 'कारण भविष्यासाठीची स्पर्धा जिंकली जाईल, जेव्हा जुने दलगत नव्या विचारांना जागा देतील — जेव्हा आम्ही समाधानांची प्राधान्यता देऊन अडथळ्यांना ठेवतो आणि आशा भीतीला बदलतो.'

article_content: Tensions are rising in the Middle East peace process after Israel announced plans to build 238 new homes in East Jerusalem, according to Israeli and U.S. officials. The move, approved by the Israeli Housing Ministry, targets neighborhoods like Pisgat Ze'ev and Ramot — areas east of the 1949 Green Line that Israel controls but which the international community largely considers occupied territory. While Israel informed the United States of its intentions, U.S. officials stressed that Washington did not endorse the plan and repeatedly urged Israel to reconsider. 'This was in no way done with U.S. approval,' said one anonymous American diplomat. Palestinian negotiator Saeb Erakat called the decision a deliberate blow to peace talks, accusing Prime Minister Netanyahu of choosing expansion over diplomacy. The announcement comes just months after a similar move during U.S. Vice President Biden’s 2010 visit, which sparked a diplomatic rift. East Jerusalem remains a core issue: Israel claims the entire city as its undivided capital, while Palestinians demand it as the capital of a future state. Meanwhile, Egypt has signaled that the Arab League may soon seek UN General Assembly recognition for Palestinian statehood — a move that could further isolate Israel diplomatically.

article_content: An academic has challenged the widely held belief that popular children’s TV shows like Peppa Pig and Thomas the Tank Engine are educational. Dr. Trina Hinkley, a researcher at Deakin University in Australia, argues in a TES journal article that claims these programs help children learn numbers, words, or languages are unfounded. After reviewing international studies on children from birth to age four, she found that excessive TV viewing can harm both physical and mental health. Children who spend more time in front of screens face higher risks of obesity and delayed cognitive development—including slower language acquisition and reduced attention spans—both critical for school readiness. Dr. Hinkley recommends parents track their children’s screen time down to the minute, noting that many are surprised to discover their kids are using electronic devices nearly twice as long as they assumed. While reducing screen time may lead to temporary tantrums, she emphasizes that schools also have a responsibility to inform parents about the potential harms of excessive television exposure.

article_content: On Saturday evening at 7:30 p.m., 22-year-old Vonterrious West was driving his Chrysler 300 along State Road 60 in Lake Wales, Florida—about 55 miles south of Orlando—when he struck 32-year-old cyclist Keith Michael Richardson. Richardson, who had been drinking and argued with his girlfriend earlier, had called his mother in Mississippi to say he intended to ride his bicycle into traffic. He had previously attempted to collide with two other vehicles, both of which successfully evaded him. Witnesses reported that West stopped briefly to inspect his vehicle for damage before driving away. Investigators believe West did not realize he had hit a person. Richardson was found dead at the scene, his bicycle damaged nearby. Authorities stated that West would likely not have faced charges if he had remained at the scene, though under Florida law, drivers are legally required to stop after any collision resulting in injury or death, regardless of awareness.

article_content: Despite an overall decline in foreign direct investment (FDI) into India, experts see growing optimism as the country attracts increased interest in greenfield investments — particularly as China records its first-ever quarterly FDI deficit. According to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), India ranks among the top three nations for greenfield FDI announcements, signaling its rising role in global supply chain diversification. A senior finance ministry official expects these trends to translate into stronger investment inflows by 2024. In contrast, China’s FDI inflows turned negative in the July–September period, aligning with a broader global push to reduce dependence on its supply chains. While India is not the only alternative, policymakers acknowledge its increasing integration into global manufacturing networks. Bibek Debroy, Chairman of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister, highlighted India’s recent progress in joining global supply chains, driven by efforts to build an FDI-friendly ecosystem and reduce reliance on China after the pandemic. Former Chief Economic Adviser KV Subramanian emphasized that India must seize this fleeting opportunity through continued structural reforms. 'The window to benefit from China’s downturn is finite,' he warned. He attributed China’s FDI collapse to deep-rooted issues: a shrinking working-age population, a bloated financial sector burdened by non-performing loans, and a real estate market crippled by oversupply and overinvestment. Meanwhile, India has taken concrete steps to boost manufacturing investment — cutting the corporate tax rate to 15% for new manufacturing units and launching Production-Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes across key industries. India’s FDI equity inflows did fall 34% to $10.9 billion in the June quarter, largely due to high domestic interest rates and global economic uncertainty affecting cross-border M&A activity. However, economists maintain a bullish long-term outlook, distinguishing short-term volatility from robust growth potential over the next three years. Rahul Bajoria of Barclays noted that while India’s FDI intentions remain strong, elevated interest rates are dampening actual investment flows — a challenge mirrored globally.
translated_content: भारतातील विदेशी सरळ गुंतवणूक (एफडीआय) मध्ये एकूण कमतरता असली तरी, तज्ञ आशावादी आहेत कारण चीनच्या पहिल्यांदाच्या चौथाई एफडीआय तोट्याच्या वेळी भारताकडे हिरव्या गुंतवणुकीकडे वाढती ओढ दिसत आहे. यूनाइटेड नेशन्स कॉन्फरन्स ऑन ट्रेड अँड डेव्हलपमेंट (UNCTAD) ने भारताच्या हिरव्या एफडीआय घोषणांमध्ये तिसऱ्या क्रमांकावर ठेवले आहे, जे जागतिक पुरवठा साखळी विविधीकरणात भारताची वाढती भूमिका दर्शवते. एक उच्च स्तरीय अर्थमंत्रालय अधिकारी 2024 पर्यंत गुंतवणुकीच्या प्रवाहात वाढ होईल अशी अपेक्षा व्यक्त करतो. तरीपण, चीनच्या एफडीआय प्रवाहांनी जुलै-सप्टेंबर कालावधीत ऋणात्मक बनवले, जे चीनवर अवलंबून असलेल्या पुरवठा साखळ्यांच्या वाढत्या अवलंबून असण्याच्या जागतिक प्रयत्नांशी जुळते. भारत हा एकमेव पर्याय नसला तरी, नियामक भारताचे जागतिक उत्पादन साखळ्यांमध्ये एकीकरण वाढत आहे असे मानतात. प्रधानमंत्र्याच्या आर्थिक सल्लागार मंडळाचे अध्यक्ष बिबेक देब्रॉय यांनी कोविडनंतर चीनवर अवलंबून असण्याचे प्रमाण कमी करण्याच्या प्रयत्नांमुळे भारताची जागतिक पुरवठा साखळ्यांमध्ये अलीकडील प्रगती दाखवली. माजी आर्थिक सल्लागार के.व्ही. सुब्रमण्यम यांनी भारताला हा फक्त काही काळासाठी उपलब्ध असलेला संधीचा वापर करण्यासाठी निरंतर संरचनात्मक सुधारणा करणे गरजेचे असल्याचे सांगितले. 'चीनच्या घसरणीपासून फायदा घेण्याची विंडो अतिशय मर्यादित आहे!' त्यांनी चेतवले. त्यांनी चीनच्या एफडीआय घसरणीचे कारण खोलच्या समस्यांमध्ये सांगितले: कामगार वयोगटातील घट, अनुपयोगी कर्जांनी भरलेला वित्तीय क्षेत्र आणि अतिरिक्त पुरवठा आणि अतिरिक्त गुंतवणूकीमुळे जखमी झालेला रिअल इस्टेट बाजार. तरीपण, भारताने नवीन उत्पादन गुंतवणुकीला उत्तेजन देण्यासाठी कृती केली आहे — नवीन उत्पादन एककांसाठी कंपनी कर दर 15% वर कमी केला आणि महत्त्वाच्या उद्योगांमध्ये उत्पादन-संबंधित प्रोत्साहन (PLI) योजना सुरू केल्या. जुने क्वार्टरमध्ये भारताच्या एफडीआय इक्विटी प्रवाहांमध्ये 34% घट झाली आणि $10.9 अब्ज झाले, जे आर्थिक तज्ञांनी उच्च व्याजदर आणि जागतिक आर्थिक अनिश्चिततेमुळे आंतरराष्ट्रीय विलीनीकरण आणि विलीनीकरणांना प्रभावित केल्याचे सांगितले. तरीपण, आर्थिक तज्ञ दीर्घकाळासाठी आशावादी राहिले आहेत, ज्यामुळे लघुकालीन अस्थिरता आणि पुढील तीन वर्षांच्या शक्तिशाली विकासाच्या नजरेने भेद केला आहे. बॅरक्लेजचे मॅनेजिंग डायरेक्टर राहुल बजोरिया यांनी भारताच्या एफडीआय इच्छांची जोरदार आहे पण उच्च व्याजदर खरोखरीच्या गुंतवणुकीला दबाव आणत आहेत असे सांगितले — ही एक जागतिक समस्या आहे.

article_content: Paul Jenkins, 35, from Caerau in south Wales, was sentenced to 15 months in prison after crashing into Karen Tatchell, a 47-year-old mother of three, while she was standing on the pavement calling for a taxi. Jenkins was driving well above the legal alcohol limit in Maesteg when he swerved onto the sidewalk and struck Ms. Tatchell, hurling her into the air before fleeing the scene. He claimed he did not realize he had hit anyone, suggesting he might have been adjusting the car stereo. However, during the trial, he also stated that voices in his head had instructed him to drive home after drinking. A psychiatric report confirmed Jenkins has a long-standing diagnosis of schizophrenia, and his mental health had recently worsened. He previously had a conviction for drink-driving. Witnesses described the incident as sudden and horrific. One bystander heard two loud bangs as the car mounted the curb; another saw Ms. Tatchell thrown to the ground while her husband lay injured beside her. Ms. Tatchell remained in a coma for an extended period and continues to suffer from significant memory loss. Recorder Jeremy Jenkins at Cardiff Crown Court said it was 'worrying' that auditory hallucinations appeared to have influenced the defendant’s decision-making, but stressed that Jenkins had knowingly chosen to drink and drive. Although his mental illness was acknowledged, the judge noted the severity of the outcome — one person critically injured — and called it a 'serious case of its kind.' Jenkins was found by police in his nearby flat, watching television. Authorities traced him after identifying a broken wing mirror matching his dark-colored vehicle. His sentence was capped at 15 months — the maximum under the law at the time — and reduced to reflect his mental health condition. He was also banned from driving for five years. A copy of his psychiatric evaluation was sent to prison with him.

article_content: The parents of a 15-month-old girl who weighed only 9 pounds at the time of her death have been arrested on one count of child abuse each. Ernest Ingram and Denise Snow-Ingram, both 38, told police they never took their daughter to a doctor due to religious beliefs. The child was found unresponsive at their Phoenix home and rushed to Phoenix Children’s Hospital on Wednesday morning, where she later died. Police reported she suffered severe malnutrition and multiple rib fractures — injuries inconsistent with accidental trauma. A healthy weight for a child her age is approximately 22 pounds; her weight matched that of a newborn. Authorities confirmed the couple were the child’s only caregivers and that no medical care had been sought since birth. When appearing in court, Denise Ingram denied harming any of their seven children, stating, 'We have never committed a felony or any criminal act before. We need time to gather evidence to prove our innocence.' Six other children, aged 3 to 12, living in the home were removed by authorities but showed no visible signs of injury. They are undergoing medical evaluations. Phoenix Police Sergeant Trent Crump noted there had been no prior calls to the residence and that the home’s living conditions were not considered a contributing factor. The couple remains jailed on a $250,000 bond. A post-mortem examination was scheduled for Thursday. Prosecutors believe the child’s extreme underweight condition directly contributed to her death. The Ingrams have not disclosed their specific religious affiliation.

article_content: Accused Italian killer Raffaele Sollecito was seen visiting the Perugia home where British exchange student Meredith Kercher was murdered in 2007, accompanied by his current girlfriend, Greta Menagaldo. The visit occurred on Thursday evening, despite Sollecito having been convicted of murder and sentenced to 25 years in prison — though he remains free while his conviction is under appeal, according to The Local. Sollecito was recently reported to have been spotted near the Austrian border at a hotel, raising further questions about his movements. A local resident expressed shock upon recognizing him: 'I couldn’t believe it. When I saw them up close, it was Sollecito,' the man told the paper. Sollecito’s father defended the visit, saying, 'If Raffaele wanted to show his girlfriend the place he went through, I don’t see anything wrong with that.' He further insisted that his son, despite two convictions, 'has absolutely nothing to do with that crime.' Amanda Knox, the American exchange student also convicted alongside Sollecito and Rudy Guede, was acquitted on appeal in 2015 and returned to the United States, vowing never to return to Italy regardless of legal outcomes. Knox, dubbed 'Foxy Knoxy' by the media, was originally sentenced to 28 years and six months. Both she and Sollecito continue to maintain their innocence and pursue all possible appeals.

article_content: In a sharp escalation of tensions, Finland has shut down four key border points with Russia after a sudden spike in asylum seekers arrived this week — a move officials say was deliberately triggered by Moscow. The Finnish government claims Russia is actively guiding migrants, many from war-torn nations like Syria, Yemen, and Iraq, to cross illegally into Finland as punishment for Helsinki’s recent decision to join NATO. Russian officials strongly deny these allegations. Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov called Finland’s actions a 'big mistake,' warning that it is unnecessarily damaging long-standing bilateral relations. 'Russia has never threatened Finland,' Peskov told TASS, stressing there was no motive for such hostility. Meanwhile, Finland’s Prime Minister Petteri Orpo stated that border guards have observed migrants being transported and even escorted to the frontier by Russian authorities. About 300 people have crossed into Finland since the beginning of the week, with 100 arriving on Friday alone. The closures affect Vaalimaa, Nuijamaa, Imatra, and Niirala in southeastern Finland, effective from Friday night. However, two northern crossings — Salla and Vartius — remain open to process asylum requests. Finnish authorities emphasize that individuals reach Russia through legal means before being moved toward the border, exploiting EU asylum rules. This situation echoes a similar tactic used in 2021, when Belarus, under Alexander Lukashenko, flew thousands of migrants to its borders with Poland and Lithuania, prompting widespread EU condemnation. Finland’s 1,340-kilometer border with Russia remains Europe’s longest — and now, its most politically charged.

'रशिया कधीही फिनलंडला धमकी दिली नाही,' पेस्कॉव यांनी टीएएएसला सांगितले, आणि असे स्पष्ट केले की अशा प्रकारच्या विरोधासाठी कोणतेही कारण नव्हते. त्याचवेळी, फिनलंडचे पंतप्रधान पेटेरी ओर्पो यांनी सांगितले की सीमापोलीसांनी आश्रयार्थींना रशियन सीमापोलीस द्वारे वाहून नेले जात आहेत आणि त्यांना सीमेकडे नेले जात आहे अशी नोंद घेतली आहे. या आठवड्याच्या सुरुवातीपासून फिनलंडमध्ये जवळपास 300 लोक आले आहेत, ज्यापैकी शुक्रवारी 100 आले. बंदी दक्षिण-पूर्व फिनलंडमधील वालिमा, नुइजामा, इमात्रा आणि नियराला येथे लागू झाली आहे आणि शुक्रवारी रात्रीपासून लागू झाली आहे. परंतु, उत्तरेकडील दोन सीमां — साल्ला आणि वार्टियस — आश्रयार्थी अर्जांसाठी खुल्या राहिल्या आहेत. फिनिश अधिकाऱ्यांचे म्हणणे आहे की व्यक्ती रशियामध्ये कायदेशीर मार्गाने प्रवेश करतात आणि नंतर युरोपियन संघाच्या आश्रयार्थी नियमांचा फायदा घेण्यासाठी सीमेकडे नेले जातात. ही परिस्थिती 2021 मध्ये वापरल्या गेलेल्या एका समान तंत्राला आठवून देते, जेव्हा बेलारूस, अलेक्सांडर लुकाशेंको यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली, हजारो आश्रयार्थी लिथुआनिया आणि पोलंड येथे आले आणि युरोपियन संघाने त्याला निंदा केली होती. फिनलंडची रशियाशी 1,340 किमीची सीमा युरोपची सर्वात लांब आहे — आणि आता, ती सर्वात राजकीय आहे.

article_content: For two decades, Jo Freestone has been a familiar and beloved figure collecting donations for the Royal British Legion in Sherborne, Dorset. Known on stage as 'Major Outrage', she’s built a reputation not just for her dedication, but for her eye-catching military-inspired burlesque outfits — a style that has drawn crowds and boosted donations since she began using it in 2010. Earlier this year, however, her local branch voted 28 to 2 to ask her to stop wearing the costume, calling it 'inappropriate' for the town’s more traditional atmosphere. The decision left Freestone stunned and deeply disappointed. 'Someone should’ve just talked to me,' she said. 'I’ve never meant to offend — I’ve always honored my grandfather’s legacy.' Her grandfather, a WWII officer and professional Shakespearean actor, once used performers to lift soldiers’ spirits — a tradition Freestone sees herself continuing. 'People don’t donate because they’re shocked — they donate because they see the effort, the heart behind it,' she explained. Thankfully, the national Royal British Legion quickly stepped in. In a clear rebuke of the local decision, a spokesperson affirmed that Freestone is not only welcome but encouraged to continue fundraising in her signature outfit. 'We’re proud of her creativity,' the statement read. 'Her performances bring joy — and generosity — to communities across the UK. Burlesque performers belong here, just like everyone else.' While Sherborne’s Poppy Appeal coordinator declined to comment, he noted the town’s large population of retired service members — many of whom likely understand the spirit behind Freestone’s tribute. With November’s Poppy Appeal approaching, Freestone remains hopeful — and ready to dance again.
translated_content: दोन दशकांपासून, जो फ्रीस्टोन ही शर्बोर्न, डोर्सेटमध्ये रॉयल ब्रिटिश लेजियनसाठी दान गोळा करणारी एक परिचित आणि प्रिय व्यक्ती आहे. 'मेजर ऑउटरेज' म्हणून अभिनय करणारी ती आपल्या निष्ठेसाठीच नव्हे, तर आपल्या लक्षणीय सैन्य-प्रेरित बर्लेस्क वेशभूषेसाठीही ओळखली जाते — ही शैली 2010 पासून लोकांचे लक्ष वेधून देऊन दान वाढवत आहे. या वर्षी प्रारंभी, तिच्या स्थानिक शाखेने 28 ते 2 या मताने तिला वेशभूषा घालू नये असे विनंती केले, आणि त्याला शहराच्या अधिक परंपरागत वातावरणासाठी 'अयोग्य' असे म्हटले. हा निर्णय फ्रीस्टोनला आश्चर्यचकित आणि खोल दुःखी केले. 'कोणी तरी मला बोलले असते,' ती म्हणाली. 'मी कधीच अपमानित करायचे नव्हते — मी नेहमीच माझ्या आजोबाचे वारसे आदराने राखले आहे.' तिचे आजोबा, एक दुसऱ्या महायुद्धाचे अधिकारी आणि व्यावसायिक शेक्सपियर अभिनेते, वेळोवेळी अभिनेते वापरून सैनिकांचे मनोबल वाढवत होते — ही परंपरा फ्रीस्टोन स्वतः चालवत आहे. 'लोक आश्चर्याने दान देत नाहीत — ते दान देतात कारण ते त्याची खरी मेहनत, त्याचे हृदय बघतात,' ती स्पष्ट केले. आनंदाची बाब म्हणजे, रॉयल ब्रिटिश लेजियनच्या राष्ट्रीय संघटनेने लवकरच हस्तक्षेप केला. स्थानिक निर्णयाची निषेध करत, एक प्रतिनिधी याची पुष्टी केली की फ्रीस्टोनला आपल्या वेशभूषेत दान गोळा करण्यास फक्त स्वागत आहे, तर तिला प्रोत्साहित करण्यात येत आहे. 'आम्हाला तिची निर्मिती आनंद झाला,' त्यांनी म्हटले. 'तिचे प्रदर्शन लोकांना आनंद आणि दानाची भावना देतात. बर्लेस्क कलाकारही इथे आहेत — इतर सर्वांसारखे.' शर्बोर्नच्या पॉपी अॅपीलचे समन्वयक याविषयी टिप्पणी करू इच्छित नाहीत, परंतु ते म्हणाले की शहरात बरेच निवृत्त सैन्य लोक आहेत — ज्यांना फ्रीस्टोनच्या आदराच्या भावनेची तुलना करता येईल. नोव्हेंबरच्या पॉपी अॅपीलच्या आगमनाची वाट पहात, फ्रीस्टोन आशावादी आहे — आणि पुन्हा नाचण्यासाठी तयार आहे.

article_content: Liverpool are nearing a £30 million double signing to help fill the offensive gap left by Luis Suarez’s departure. The club is close to securing Belgian striker Divock Origi from Lille for approximately £10 million and Serbian winger Lazar Markovic from Benfica for £19.8 million—the latter triggered by the activation of his release clause. Origi arrived at Liverpool’s Melwood training ground on Wednesday to discuss personal terms and is expected to undergo his medical alongside Markovic on Thursday. While Liverpool lead the race for both players, Tottenham and Atletico Madrid are also monitoring Origi’s situation closely. Manager Brendan Rodgers is eager to reinvest the £75 million received from Suarez’s transfer to Barcelona. Markovic, 20, has made 49 appearances for Benfica, scoring seven goals last season, and has earned 12 caps for Serbia. Origi, 19, impressed at the 2014 World Cup by scoring against Russia after coming on for Romelu Lukaku and netted seven goals in 45 games for Lille. When asked about his future at an event in his hometown of Houthalen-Helchteren, Origi remained noncommittal. 'I’m still thinking about it,' he said. 'There are offers from across Europe. I need to choose where I’ll grow best—as a player and as a person. I expect things to become clearer within the next two weeks.'

article_content: Danny Alexander, Treasury Chief Secretary, has warned of an 'explosion of aggressive advertising' during sporting events broadcast before the 9pm watershed, citing concerns that children are routinely exposed to casino and betting ads. Leaked cabinet correspondence reveals growing friction within the Coalition over whether to reverse Labour’s 2007 decision to remove restrictions on gambling commercials. Research shows children as young as four encounter gambling advertisements more than 200 times annually. In a letter to Culture Secretary Sajid Javid, Alexander criticized the delay in publishing a long-overdue government review of gambling advertising, stating, 'This is a matter of principle, and I believe the time to act is now.' The Royal College of Psychiatrists previously warned that unrestricted advertising leads to increased problem gambling. Since Labour’s reforms, gambling ads have surged by 1,500%, accounting for 4% of all TV advertising. Campaigners argue these ads—often featuring celebrities like Ray Winstone for Bet365—normalize gambling by portraying it as a fun, easy way to make money, particularly during live sports. While William Hill, Ladbrokes, Paddy Power, and Coral have voluntarily banned pre-9pm free-bet ads, critics say this is insufficient. Alexander emphasized that while adults have the right to gamble, many parents no longer find the ad content acceptable during family viewing. Lib Dem MP Tessa Munt has called for legislative action to curb what she describes as the 'insidious' rise of gaming promotions, warning of devastating impacts from addiction and debt. The government’s review, expected last year, remains unpublished, with experts still evaluating whether the 9pm watershed remains adequate and if stronger regulations are needed.

article_content: Saudi Arabia is reportedly exploring the purchase of 54 Dassault Rafale fighter jets from France—a move that could mark its first acquisition of a French-made combat aircraft, despite decades of French efforts to secure such a deal. According to the French financial weekly La Tribune, Riyadh has formally requested a detailed quote from Dassault Aviation, with a response deadline of November 10. While this does not guarantee a deal, it signals serious interest. The potential order follows Germany’s firm refusal to approve additional Eurofighter Typhoon sales to Saudi Arabia. German Chancellor Olaf Scholz confirmed in July that no decision on such deliveries will be made anytime soon, citing unresolved human rights concerns stemming from the 2018 murder of journalist Jamal Khashoggi. With one-third of the Typhoon’s components sourced from Germany, Berlin holds veto power over exports. Riyadh currently operates advanced U.S.-made F-15SA jets and British Eurofighter Typhoons, alongside aging Panavia Tornados. Acquiring Rafales would diversify its fleet and reduce reliance on any single supplier—a strategic priority heightened by recent tensions with the U.S., including threats from Congress to freeze arms sales after Saudi Arabia supported OPEC+ oil production cuts last October. This isn't the first time Riyadh has used arms procurement as diplomatic leverage. In the late 1970s, it threatened to buy French Mirage F1s to pressure the U.S. into approving a major F-15 sale. Similarly, the UAE suspended its F-35 deal in 2021 and swiftly secured 80 Rafales from France. Qatar, too, has diversified by ordering jets from multiple Western nations. Analysts suggest Saudi Arabia may be using the Rafale inquiry to pressure the UK into lobbying Germany to lift its veto—or risk losing a major contract. The kingdom may also be preparing for a historic shift: fielding French fighter jets for the first time, possibly in quantities as high as 100–200, as previously reported by La Tribune based on anonymous sources.

ब्रिटनला दबाव आणण्यासाठी राफेलची विनंती वापरू शकते—नाहीतर एक मोठा व्यवहार गमावू शकते. रियाद आता फ्रेंच लढाऊ विमाने वापरण्याच्या ऐतिहासिक बदलाची तयारी करू शकते: ला ट्रिब्यूनच्या अतिरिक्त अनामिक The footage includes shots of a taxi driving through the borough, with Sutton’s civic buildings clearly visible in the background. Later scenes show performers outside the vehicle, with the local skyline unmistakable. While the council confirmed the car park has CCTV, it emphasized that the incident occurred before recent security upgrades — including safety barriers, locked gates, and anti-climb paint — were installed to deter unauthorized access. Councillor Shields questioned whether the location had become an unwitting hub for illicit filming, remarking, 'I did not think Sutton was a favoured porn film location — but it seems it is rather the porn capital.' A police spokesperson confirmed the council provided a web link to authorities, and joint efforts are underway to identify those responsible. Appropriate legal action will follow. The Safer Neighbourhood Team has been instructed to increase patrols, and the council reiterated that filming on public property without permission is illegal.

article_content: A businessman accused of attempting to deny his former wife a substantial financial settlement transferred £250,000 worth of shares in his company to his partner, Massahine Bojji. Multi-millionaire Christopher Nightingale ended his 25-year marriage to Sally Nightingale after beginning a relationship with Bojji, whom he met at a London lap-dancing club in 2007. He later supported her right to remain in the UK and claimed that Sally was no longer entitled to the £1.6 million she had been promised from the sale of shares in Citadel100, reducing her payout to just £83. Nightingale, a former lawyer based in Singapore who owns a chateau in France, provided Bojji with a luxury home in west London while still married. She gave birth to their son, Faris, in February 2009. He divorced Sally a year later. Sally now resides in Appleby Castle, a Grade I listed property in Cumbria, which she received as part of their divorce agreement. In 2009, Nightingale transferred 42,318,000 shares in his Singapore-registered company, Alternative Energy, to Bojji, valued at approximately £252,000. Although the financial terms of the divorce were reportedly settled in 2009, Sally remained entitled to proceeds from the £6.6 million sale of Citadel100 shares. In July of the previous year, Nightingale emailed Sally promising over £1.6 million — nearly a quarter of the total — but later revised this to £83, claiming the sale had been 'very hard work' and more complicated than anticipated. In December, the High Court froze Nightingale’s UK assets. A judge criticized him in January for presenting widely inconsistent financial offers. The couple reached a confidential out-of-court settlement after five hours of private negotiations. Mr Justice Mostyn welcomed the resolution, urging both parties to move forward. Nightingale denied that Bojji was a pole dancer, describing her as 'a bright and intelligent lady.' He stated the shares given to her were currently suspended and thus valueless, and emphasized that Sally had received a settlement worth 'many millions' to retain Appleby Castle. Sally countered that she is 'asset rich but cash poor,' needing funds to maintain the historic property. Nightingale claimed he could not afford his own legal fees.

article_content: Despite torrential rain, widespread flooding, evacuations, and power outages, Sochi is mounting a massive effort to ensure readiness for the 2014 Winter Olympics. On Tuesday, streets and homes were inundated, prompting Russia’s Emergencies Ministry to confirm a state of emergency was still active — a reversal after earlier denials, according to RIA Novosti. Approximately 1,800 workers are now engaged in cleanup operations. While flooding persists in parts of the village of Mirny and several train stations in Adler, rescue teams have made progress: water has been pumped out, and limited train services have resumed. All 30 residents evacuated from the village of Kepsha have safely returned home after water levels dropped from 45 centimeters to just 5 cm. Severe weather grounded flights at Sochi’s regional airports and caused major traffic disruptions. Kubanenergo, the local power provider, shut off electricity in five areas to prevent cascading blackouts. The floods strike at a critical moment: the International Olympic Committee’s Coordination Committee was in Sochi for its final pre-Games inspection from September 24 to 26. Chairman Jean-Claude Killy concluded his visit after touring mountain venues. The IOC issued a statement asserting the weather had not hindered their work, adding that their visit to the mountain venues was 'successful.' Olympstroy, the Olympic construction authority, firmly denied any damage to venues in the Imeretinskaya lowland and Krasnaya Polyana. They emphasized that all new facilities were constructed under strict standards for seismic, weather, and geological safety — including protections against mudslides and landslides. Service teams are reportedly stationed across both mountain and coastal zones to maintain operations.

IOC ने असे विधान केले की हवामानामुळे त्यांचे काम अडचणीत पडले नव्हते, आणि त्यांची पर्वतीय वेन्यूवरील भेट 'यशस्वी' होती. ओलिंपस्ट्रॉय, ऑलिंपिक बांधकाम अधिकारी, यांनी इमेरेटिन्स्काया खोऱ्यात आणि क्रास्नाया पोलियानामध्ये कोणतेही वेन्यू नुकसान पावले नाहीत असे ठामपणे नकारले. त्यांनी असे भर दिले की सर्व नवीन सुविधा भूकंपीय, हवामान आणि भूतत्त्वशास्त्रीय सुरक्षिततेच्या कठोर मानकांनुसार बांधल्या गेल्या होत्या — ज्यामध्ये वाळूच्या वाहाणां आणि खाणींच्या संरक्षणाचा समावेश होता. सेवा टीम्स दोन्ही पर्वतीय आणि किनारपट्टीच्या क्लस्टर्समध्ये उपलब्ध आहेत जेणेकरून सुविधा योग्य प्रकारे कार्यरत राहतील.

article_content: For almost five years, 19-year-old Ayllah-Beau Foley hasn't eaten a traditional meal. Diagnosed with gastroparesis — a rare disorder where stomach muscles stop working — her body can't process food at all. Instead, she receives all her nutrients through a tube inserted into her jugular vein, delivering nourishment directly into her bloodstream. Every night, for 14 hours, she’s hooked up to a drip that keeps her alive, bypassing her entire digestive system. Her journey began after returning from a school volunteering trip to India. At first, everyone — including her family and doctors — thought she had a simple case of traveler’s sickness, commonly called 'Delhi belly.' But as weeks turned into months and her health worsened, medical professionals explored every possibility: appendicitis, gynecological problems, even mental health concerns. One doctor even suggested her symptoms might be 'all in her head.' Her mother, Christine, recalls how painful that was: 'We knew it wasn’t psychological. She was suffering, visibly and desperately.' Eventually, specialists confirmed gastroparesis — a condition where the nerves controlling stomach contractions are damaged, leaving food trapped and causing constant nausea, vomiting, and extreme weight loss. Ayllah-Beau lost nearly three stone. Treatments followed: a feeding tube into her intestines, a gastric pacemaker designed to stimulate muscle movement — all failed. Now, IV nutrition is her only lifeline. The emotional toll is profound. She can’t share birthday cakes with her twin brother Jordan, can’t join friends for pizza or Sunday roasts, and spends most days resting, watching their lives unfold online. She still craves chocolate, burgers, sweets — tiny bites occasionally bring fleeting comfort, but always end in sickness. 'I used to love food,' she says. 'Now I just miss it.' Dr. Simon Gabe, a gastroenterologist at St Mark’s Hospital, explains that gastroparesis affects about 1 in 50,000 people and is far more common in women. Often, young women with symptoms like vomiting and weight loss are wrongly labeled as having eating disorders. 'We’re seeing more cases like Ayllah-Beau’s,' he says. 'It’s not just the stomach — sometimes the whole gut loses coordination. And when that happens, the cause remains a mystery.' Though there’s no cure, Ayllah-Beau refuses to give up. She raises funds for St Mark’s Hospital, hoping to support research that might one day restore her ability to eat. 'I just want to be normal again,' she says. 'Until then, I take each day as it comes — and I stay hopeful.'
translated_content: अंदाजे पाच वर्षांपासून, 19 वर्षीय ऐल्ला-बो मूली याने सामान्य आहार घेतला नाही. गॅस्ट्रोपॅरेसिस असल्याचे निदान झाले आहे — ही एक दुर्मिळ आजार आहे ज्यामध्ये पोटाच्या स्नायूंचे काम बंद होते — तिच्या शरीराला अन्न पचवता येत नाही. त्याऐवजी, ती सर्व पोषक तत्त्वे आपल्या जुग्युलर शिरेत ठेवलेल्या नळीद्वारे आपल्या रक्तप्रवाहात पाठवली जातात. प्रत्येक रात्री, 14 तास, ती एका ड्रिपद्वारे जोडली जाते जी तिला जिवंत ठेवते, आणि तिच्या पूर्ण पाचन प्रणालीचे वर्चस्व टाळते. तिची वाटचाल भारतात शाळेच्या स्वयंसेवी प्रवासापासून परतल्यानंतर सुरू झाली. प्रथम, सर्व — तिच्या कुटुंबासह वैद्यकीय तज्ञ — तिला साधारण फेरीच्या आजार, ज्याला 'दिल्ली बेल्ली' म्हणतात, असे वाटले. पण आठवड्यांनी महिन्यांनी तिचे आरोग्य खाली गेले आणि औषधज्ञांनी प्रत्येक शक्यता तपासली: अपेंडिसिस, जननेंद्रिय समस्या, तरीही मानसिक आजार. एक डॉक्टर याला 'मनातला आजार' असे म्हणाला. तिच्या आई, क्रिस्टिन यांनी सांगितले: 'आम्हाला माहित होते की हे मानसिक नव्हते. ती दुखत होती, दृश्यपणे आणि अत्यंत असमर्थ होती.' शेवटी, तज्ञांनी गॅस्ट्रोपॅरेसिस निदान केले — एक अशी स्थिती ज्यामध्ये पोटाच्या संकुचनांसाठी जबाबदार नर्व्ह्स नुकसान पावल्यामुळे अन्न अडकून राहते आणि निरंतर ऊती, उलट्या आणि अत्यंत वजन कमी होते. ऐल्ला-बोली यांनी अंदाजे तीन स्टोन वजन कमी केले. उपचार झाले: पोटात नळी, जी स्नायूंना उत्तेजित करण्यासाठी डिझाइन केलेली गॅस्ट्रिक पेसमेकर — दोन्ही अयशस्वी झाले. आता, आय.व्ही. पोषण ही तिची एकमेव जिवंतीची राहत आहे. भावनिक ओझे खूप भारी आहे. ती आपल्या जुडी जॉर्डनशी बर्थडे केक शेअर करू शकत नाही, मित्रांसोबत पिझ्झा किंवा सनडे रॉस्ट खाऊ शकत नाही, आणि बहुतेक दिवस ओरडत बसून तिच्या मित्रांच्या जीवनाचे फेसबुकवर पाहते. तिला चॉकलेट, बर्गर, मिठाई यांची इच्छा असते — कधीकधी लहान घेणे थोडे संतोष देते, पण वेदना येते. 'मला अन्न आवडत होते,' ती म्हणते. 'आता मला फक्त ते आठवते.' सेंट मार्क्स रुग्णालयातील गॅस्ट्रोएंटेरोलॉजिस्ट डॉ. सायमन गेबे यांनी सांगितले की गॅस्ट्रोपॅरेसिस यामध्ये एक लोकसंख्येपैकी 50,000 जण ग्रस्त असतात आणि ती स्त्रियांमध्ये जास्त आढळते. वयाच्या तरुणींमध्ये ऊती आणि वजन कमी होणे हे अन्न घेण्याच्या आजाराचे लक्षण असे वाटते, पण अशा काही रुग्णांमध्ये गॅस्ट्रोपॅरेसिस योगदान देत असते. 'आम्ही ऐल्ला-बोलीसारख्या प्रकरणांची संख्या वाढत आहे,' ते म्हणतात. 'हे फक्त पोटाची समस्या नाही — कधीकधी संपूर्ण आंत्रे योग्य तरी न काम करतात. आणि तेव्हा कारण अज्ञातच राहते.' हा आजार बरा होऊ शकत नाही, पण ऐल्ला-बोली आशा गमावत नाही. ती सेंट मार्क्स रुग्णालयासाठी निधी गोळा करते, ज्यामुळे एकदा तिच्या खाण्याची क्षमता परत मिळू शकेल अशी संशोधनाची आशा आहे. 'मला फक्त सामान्य व्हायचे आहे,' ती म्हणते. 'तोपर्यंत, मी प्रत्येक दिवस जशाचा तसा घेते — आणि मी आशावादी राहते.'

article_content: Britain's competition watchdog, the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA), said on Friday it had accepted binding commitments from tech giants Amazon and Meta to protect fair competition on their retail platforms. These commitments conclude the CMA's investigation into Amazon Marketplace and Meta's use of advertising data. Amazon has pledged not to use data from third-party sellers to gain an unfair competitive advantage, ensuring that independent sellers have a fair chance to be featured in the 'Buy Box'. Meta has committed to preventing the exploitation of advertisers' data by allowing them to opt out of having their information used to improve Facebook Marketplace. Meta welcomed the CMA's decision. The CMA had indicated in July that Amazon's proposed changes addressed its preliminary competition concerns.

article_content: After serving seven years for attempted murder, Scott Kelly was released on probation in April 2023 — but within months, he broke the terms of his release and vanished overseas. The 33-year-old, convicted in 2005 for stabbing Stephen Rank during a bar fight in Exeter, fled from his bail hostel in October 2023 and headed to Europe, first skiing, then settling in Spain’s Costa Blanca region. While on the run, Kelly regularly shared photos on Facebook, documenting his travels: meals with friends, drinks by the sea, and even a ski trip. But one seemingly innocent post — a sunset over the ocean with a distinctive line of palm trees lining the promenade — gave him away. UK police, working with Interpol and the National Crime Agency, analyzed the image and matched the coastal landscape to Alicante, Spain. Spanish authorities acted swiftly, locating Kelly driving in the area and arresting him last month. He was detained under a European Arrest Warrant and extradited back to the UK this week, where he has now been returned to prison. Detective Inspector Paul Fell of the Zephyr unit noted that Kelly clearly believed he could escape justice by hiding abroad. 'They don’t like having British criminals thinking they’re above the law here,' Fell said, highlighting Spain’s willingness to cooperate. Authorities stressed that Kelly’s public postings revealed not just his whereabouts, but his dangerous arrogance — treating his freedom as a vacation rather than a privilege granted under strict conditions.

'त्यांना ब्रिटिश गुन्हेगार येथे राहून ते अधिकाऱ्यांपासून अछूत आहेत असे वाटू देत नाहीत,' फेल यांनी म्हटले, ज्यामुळे स्पेनच्या सहकार्याचे महत्त्व उजळले. अधिकाऱ्यांनी भर दिला की केलीचे सार्वजनिक पोस्ट फक्त त्याचे ठिकाण नव्हे तर त्याचे धोकादायक अभिमानही उघड करत होते — त्याने आपली स्वातंत्र्याची अटी एक विक्रमाच्या विक्रमाप्रमाणे घेतली.

article_content: With Thanksgiving sales underway and Christmas just around the corner, many are focused on gift shopping — and the costs that come with it. But a new mobile app, Rewardable, is here to help ease the financial burden by paying users to shop, dine, and even stay at home. Available for both iPhone and Android, Rewardable lets users earn money by completing simple tasks like reviewing products, photographing store signage, checking prices, or sharing feedback on social media. One user reportedly earned over $100 in a single weekend simply by snapping photos of local store displays and rating service at a fast-food outlet. For companies, the app functions as a crowd-sourced audit system — providing real-time data on product availability, pricing, promotional displays, and customer experience without the need for expensive in-person inspections. Tasks typically take just a few minutes and pay between $3 and $15. Most are located in stores, restaurants, and pharmacies across the United States, though some can be completed remotely — such as completing surveys, testing apps, or promoting campaigns online. Users browse available tasks via a map or list view, follow clear instructions, and submit their responses through the app. The Rewardable team reviews submissions before approving payments, which are sent directly to users’ PayPal accounts. Camille Whaley of Newtown, Connecticut, said: 'I’ve been using it while shopping for weeks and already made over $100. The tasks are actually fun — last week, I got a free meal just for reviewing the service.' Peter Komassa, co-founder of Rewardable, explained: 'It gives consumers a little extra cash, helps stores improve, supports brands — and most of all, it’s fun.' Anshuman Vohra, CEO of BULLDOG Gin, noted: 'We got comprehensive, accurate data in weeks — something that would’ve taken months with our sales team.' Retailers, restaurants, consumer brands, and even real estate and financial firms are now using Rewardable as a fast, affordable alternative to traditional market research. The app is available on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
